முன்னுரிமை நடவடிக்கை ஏன் மிகவும் முக்கியமானது
1 எல்லா இடங்களிலும் இரண்டு காரணி அங்கீகாரத்தை இயக்கவும்-திருடப்பட்ட அல்லது யூகிக்கப்பட்ட கடவுச்சொல்-அதன் சொந்தமாக போதுமானதாக இருப்பதிலிருந்து மிகவும் பொதுவான தாக்குதலைத் தடுக்கிறது. ஒவ்வொரு முக்கிய தளத்திலும் இலவசம்.
2 குழு முழுவதும் கடவுச்சொல் மேலாளரைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள் பகிரப்பட்ட கடவுச்சொற்கள், மறுபயன்பாட்டு கடவுச்சொற்கள் மற்றும் காகிதத்தில் எழுதப்பட்ட கடவுச்சொற்கள் ஆகியவற்றை முடிக்கவும். ஊழியர்கள் வெளியேறும்போது கையளிப்பதையும் தீர்க்கிறது.
3 மக்கள் வெளியேறும்போது அணுகலை அகற்றவும் முன்னாள் ஊழியர்கள் மற்றும் ஒப்பந்தக்காரர்கள் நேரடி அணுகலைத் தக்கவைத்துக்கொள்வது மிகவும் பொதுவான மற்றும் மிகவும் தவிர்க்கக்கூடிய NGO பாதிப்புகளில் ஒன்றாகும்.
4 ஃபிஷிங்கை அடையாளம் காண ஊழியர்களுக்கு பயிற்சி அளித்தல் பெரும்பாலான மீறல்கள் யாராவது எதையாவது கிளிக் செய்வதன் மூலம் தொடங்குகின்றன. இருபது நிமிட பயிற்சி பெரும்பாலான தொழில்நுட்பக் கட்டுப்பாடுகளை முறியடிக்கிறது.
5 உங்கள் தரவை காப்புப் பிரதி எடுக்கவும், மீட்டமைக்கும் ரான்சம்வேர் மற்றும் தற்செயலான நீக்குதல் ஆகிய இரண்டுமே வேலை செய்யும் காப்புப்பிரதியுடன் உயிர்வாழக்கூடியவை என்பதைச் சோதிக்கவும். சோதிக்கப்படாத காப்புப்பிரதி ஒரு காப்புப்பிரதி அல்ல.

கவனிக்கத் தக்கது.
ஐந்தில் நான்குக்கு எந்த செலவும் இல்லை என்பதைக் கவனியுங்கள். சிறிய தன்னார்வ தொண்டு நிறுவனங்கள் மிகவும் பலவீனமாக இருக்கும் இடங்களில் பாதுகாப்புச் செலவு அரிதாகவே உள்ளது-நடைமுறையில் உள்ளது.

நீங்கள் கோரக்கூடிய இலவச பாதுகாப்பு
Cloudflare திட்டம் கலிலியோ
பொது நலன் சார்ந்த பணிகளைச் செய்யும் நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இலவச நிறுவன தரப் பாதுகாப்பு-இது Cloudflare இன் கட்டண வணிகத் திட்டத்திற்கு சமம். இதில் அளவிடப்படாத DDoS தணிப்பு, ஒரு வலை பயன்பாட்டு ஃபயர்வால், CDN, SSL சான்றிதழ்கள் மற்றும் பூஜ்ஜிய நம்பிக்கை அணுகல் கட்டுப்பாடுகள் ஆகியவை அடங்கும்.
மனித உரிமைகள் வக்காலத்து, சிவில் சமூகம் மற்றும் ஜனநாயகம் ஆதரவு, பத்திரிகை மற்றும் ஊடகம் மற்றும் கலை மற்றும் கலாச்சார வெளிப்பாடு ஆகியவற்றை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டது.
நீங்கள் வெளிப்படுத்துவதை அனுமதிக்காவிட்டால் Cloudflare பங்கேற்கும் நிறுவனங்களை ரகசியமாக வைத்திருக்கிறது.
நேரடியாகவோ அல்லது Cloudflare இன் 40 + கூட்டாளர் அமைப்புகளில் ஒன்றின் மூலமாகவோ விண்ணப்பிக்கவும்-கூட்டாளர் வழி பொதுவாக வேகமாக இருக்கும்.
தனி Cloudflare திட்ட கலிலியோ வழிகாட்டியில் முழுமையாக மூடப்பட்டுள்ளது.
Google திட்டக் கேடயம்
செய்தி நிறுவனங்கள், மனித உரிமைக் குழுக்கள் மற்றும் தேர்தல் கண்காணிப்பு அமைப்புகளை இலக்காகக் கொண்ட Google இன் சமமான இலவச டி. டி. ஓ. எஸ் பாதுகாப்பு சேவை. அதற்கு பதிலாக கலிலியோவுடன் இணைந்து மதிப்பிடுவது மதிப்புக்குரியது-தகுதி ஒன்றுடன் ஒன்று ஆனால் ஒரே மாதிரியாக இல்லை, மேலும் இரண்டையும் விசாரிப்பதற்கு அபராதம் இல்லை.
தயவுசெய்து சரிபார்க்கவும்
இந்த வழிகாட்டியின் ஆராய்ச்சியின் போது ப்ராஜெக்ட் ஷீல்ட்டின் தற்போதைய விதிமுறைகளை சரிபார்க்க முடியவில்லை, ஏனெனில் அதன் பக்கங்கள் படிக்கக்கூடிய உள்ளடக்கத்தை தானியங்கி பெறுதலுக்குத் திருப்பித் தரவில்லை. தற்போது என்ன வழங்கப்படுகிறது என்பதை உறுதிப்படுத்த உலாவியில் projectshield.withgoogle.com ஐப் பார்வையிடவும்.
இலாப நோக்கற்ற மென்பொருளில் பாதுகாப்பு சேர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளது
Microsoft 365 பிசினஸ் பிரீமியம்-75 சதவீதம் இலாப நோக்கற்ற தள்ளுபடியில் கிடைக்கிறது-இதில் நிறுவன பாதுகாப்பு அம்சங்கள் அடங்கும், பல தன்னார்வ தொண்டு நிறுவனங்கள் தாங்கள் ஏற்கனவே பணம் செலுத்துவதை உணரவில்லை.
இலாப நோக்கற்ற நிறுவனங்களுக்கான Google Workspace உங்கள் களம் முழுவதும் அமல்படுத்தப்பட்ட இரண்டு காரணி அங்கீகாரம் உட்பட கணக்கு பாதுகாப்பு கட்டுப்பாடுகளை உள்ளடக்கியது.
நீங்கள் இரண்டையும் வைத்திருந்தால், பாதுகாப்பு அம்சங்கள் ஏற்கனவே உங்களுடையவை; புதிய ஒன்றை வாங்குவதை விட அவற்றை இயக்குவதே பணியாகும்.


பயனாளிகளின் தரவுகளைப் பாதுகாத்தல்
இங்குதான் NGO பாதுகாப்பு வணிக பாதுகாப்பிலிருந்து அர்த்தமுள்ள வகையில் வேறுபடுகிறது. வாடிக்கையாளர் தரவைப் பாதுகாக்கும் ஒரு நிறுவனம் வணிக மற்றும் ஒழுங்குமுறை விளைவுகளை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. வன்முறையில் இருந்து தப்பியவர்கள், களங்கமான நிலைமைகளுடன் வாழும் மக்கள் அல்லது சர்ச்சைக்குரிய அரசியல் சூழலில் சமூக உறுப்பினர்கள் பற்றிய பதிவுகளை வைத்திருக்கும் ஒரு அமைப்பு, மீறல் உங்களை நம்பிய ஒருவருக்கு நேரடி தீங்கு விளைவிக்கும் வாய்ப்பை எதிர்கொள்கிறது.
பெரும்பாலான எடையைக் கொண்டு செல்லும் நடைமுறை நடவடிக்கைகள்ஃ
குறைவாக சேகரிக்கவும். நீங்கள் ஒருபோதும் சேகரிக்காத தரவு கசிந்துவிட முடியாது. உங்கள் உட்கொள்ளும் படிவத்தில் உள்ள ஒவ்வொரு புலமும் உண்மையிலேயே பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறதா என்று மதிப்பாய்வு செய்யுங்கள்.
பாத்திரத்தின் அடிப்படையில் அணுகலை கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். எல்லோரும் எல்லாவற்றையும் பார்க்க வேண்டிய அவசியமில்லை. பெரும்பாலான அமைப்புகள் இதை ஆதரிக்கின்றன, பெரும்பாலான நிறுவனங்கள் அதை கட்டமைக்கவில்லை.
வேலை அனுமதிக்கும் இடத்தில் வழக்கு விவரங்களிலிருந்து அடையாளம் காணும் விவரங்களை பிரிக்கவும்.
தரவு எங்கு வாழ்கிறது என்பதைப் பற்றி வேண்டுமென்றே இருங்கள். தனிப்பட்ட மடிக்கணினி அல்லது வாட்ஸ்அப் குழுவில் ஒரு விரிதாள் சேமிப்பு அல்ல; அது வெளிப்பாடு.
ஏதாவது கசிந்தால் என்ன நடக்கும் என்பதற்கான ஒரு திட்டத்தை வைத்திருங்கள்-யாருக்கு சொல்லப்படுகிறது, எந்த வரிசையில், பாதிக்கப்பட்ட மக்களுக்கு எவ்வாறு தெரிவிக்கப்படுகிறது.

இந்தியச் சட்டம் பற்றி
இந்தியாவின் டிஜிட்டல் தனிநபர் தரவு பாதுகாப்புச் சட்டம், 2023 தனிப்பட்ட தரவைக் கையாளும் நிறுவனங்களுக்கான கடமைகளை உருவாக்குகிறது. அதன் விரிவான விதிகள் மற்றும் அமலாக்கம் உருவாகி வருகின்றன, மேலும் இந்த வழிகாட்டி தற்போதைய நிலையை சுருக்க முயற்சிக்கவில்லை. நீங்கள் எந்த அளவிலும் முக்கியமான பயனாளித் தரவை வைத்திருந்தால், இது ஒரு சரிபார்ப்பு பட்டியலைக் காட்டிலும் சரியான சட்ட ஆலோசனைக்கு மதிப்புள்ளது-மேலும் உங்கள் இணக்க பிரிவில் அதன் சொந்த கட்டுரைக்கு வலுவான வேட்பாளராகும்.


ஒரு யதார்த்தமான தொடக்க வரிசை
1.	யாருக்கு என்ன அணுகல் உள்ளது என்பதைத் தணிக்கை செய்யுங்கள். ஒவ்வொரு கணினியையும், உள்நுழைவு கொண்ட ஒவ்வொரு நபரையும் பட்டியலிடுங்கள். பொதுவாக ஒரு முன்னாள் ஊழியருக்கு இன்னும் நிர்வாக உரிமைகள் இருப்பதை நிறுவனங்கள் கண்டுபிடிக்கும் தருணம் இது.
2.	முதலில் மின்னஞ்சலில் இரண்டு காரணி அங்கீகாரத்தை செயல்படுத்துங்கள், பின்னர் மற்ற அனைத்தும். மின்னஞ்சல் முக்கிய விசையாகும்-அதை யார் கட்டுப்படுத்துகிறார்களோ அவர்கள் மீதமுள்ளவற்றை மீட்டமைக்கலாம்.
3.	ஒரு கடவுச்சொல் மேலாளரைத் தத்தெடுத்து, ஒரு பதினைந்து நாட்களுக்குள் குழுவை இடமாற்றம் செய்யுங்கள்.
4.	ஒவ்வொரு முக்கியமான அமைப்புக்கும் இரண்டாவது நிர்வாகியை நியமிக்கவும், எனவே எந்தக் கணக்கும் ஒரு நபரைப் பொறுத்தது அல்ல.
5.	இருபது நிமிட ஃபிஷிங் விழிப்புணர்வு அமர்வை நடத்துங்கள். அவற்றை சுருக்கமாக விவரிப்பதை விட உண்மையான எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளைக் காட்டுங்கள்.
6.	உண்மையில் எதையாவது மீட்டமைப்பதன் மூலம் உங்கள் காப்புப்பிரதிகளைச் சரிபார்க்கவும்.
7.	உங்கள் வேலை விரோதமான கவனத்தை ஈர்க்க வாய்ப்பிருந்தால், கலிலியோவின் Cloudflare திட்டத்திற்கு விண்ணப்பிக்கவும்.
8.	ஆஃப்போர்டிங் படிகளை எழுதுங்கள், இதனால் அணுகலை அகற்றுவது நினைவில் கொள்வதை விட வழக்கமானதாக மாறும்.

விரைவான சரிபார்ப்பு பட்டியல்
ஒவ்வொரு அமைப்பு மற்றும் அணுகல் உள்ள அனைவரையும் பட்டியலிடுங்கள்
மின்னஞ்சலில் தொடங்கி இரண்டு காரணி அங்கீகாரத்தை செயல்படுத்தவும்
குழு முழுவதும் கடவுச்சொல் மேலாளரை உருட்டவும்
ஒவ்வொரு முக்கியமான கணக்கிற்கும் இரண்டாவது நிர்வாகியை நியமிக்கவும்
* வெளியேறிய எவருக்கும் அணுகலை அகற்றவும்
உண்மையான எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளுடன் ஒரு குறுகிய ஃபிஷிங் விழிப்புணர்வு அமர்வை இயக்கவும்
காப்புப்பிரதிகள் உள்ளன என்பது மட்டுமல்லாமல், காப்புப்பிரதி மீட்டமைப்பைச் சோதிக்கவும்
நீங்கள் சேகரிக்கும் பயனாளிகளின் தரவு என்ன என்பதையும், அவை அனைத்தும் உங்களுக்குத் தேவையா என்பதையும் மதிப்பாய்வு செய்யுங்கள்.
உங்கள் வேலை விரோதமான கவனத்தை ஈர்த்தால் கலிலியோவின் Cloudflare திட்டத்திற்கு விண்ணப்பிக்கவும்
உங்கள் ஆஃப் போர்டிங் நடைமுறையை எழுதுங்கள்

ஆதாரங்கள்
Cloudflare திட்டம் கலிலியோ https://www.cloudflare.com/galileo/
Google திட்ட கவசம் https://projectshield.withgoogle.com/
Microsoft 365 இலாப நோக்கற்ற சலுகைகள் (வணிக பிரீமியம் பாதுகாப்பு அம்சங்கள்)https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/nonprofits/microsoft-365

குறிப்புஃ இந்த வழிகாட்டியில் உள்ள நடைமுறை பாதுகாப்பு வழிகாட்டுதல் எந்தவொரு ஒற்றை மேற்கோள் மூலத்தையும் விட நன்கு நிறுவப்பட்ட தொழில்முறை நடைமுறையை பிரதிபலிக்கிறது. மேலே உள்ள பக்கங்களிலிருந்து Cloudflare மற்றும் Microsoft விவரங்கள் உறுதிப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன. திட்ட கேடயத்தின் விதிமுறைகளும் தற்போதைய DPDP சட்டத்தின் விதிகளும் ஆராய்ச்சியின் போது சரிபார்க்கப்படவில்லை, அவை நேரடியாக சரிபார்க்கப்பட வேண்டும்.

ఎన్జీఓల కోసం సైబర్ సెక్యురిటీ

మీ సైట్, మీ డేటా మరియు మీ సిబ్బంది ఖాతాలను రక్షించడం
ఎన్జీఓల కోసం సిద్ధం | ఆగస్టు 2026

ఎన్జీఓలను ఎందుకు లక్ష్యంగా చేసుకుంటారు
లాభాపేక్షలేని సంస్థలు మూడు కారణాల వల్ల దాడి చేయబడతాయి, వాటిలో ఏదీ దాడి చేసేవారు మీ లక్ష్యాన్ని ఇష్టపడరు. మొదటిది, మీరు విలువైన డేటాను కలిగి ఉంటారు-దాత చెల్లింపు వివరాలు, లబ్ధిదారు రికార్డులు, కొన్నిసార్లు హాని కలిగించే వ్యక్తుల గురించి సున్నితమైన సమాచారం. రెండవది, మీరు తులనాత్మక పరిమాణంలో ఉన్న వ్యాపారం కంటే బలహీనమైన రక్షణను కలిగి ఉంటారు, ఇది మిమ్మల్ని సమర్థవంతమైన లక్ష్యంగా చేస్తుంది. మూడవది, మీ పని మానవ హక్కులు, జర్నలిజం, ఎన్నికలు లేదా పోటీ విధానాన్ని తాకినట్లయితే, మిమ్మల్ని నిశ్శబ్దం చేయడానికి ఉద్దేశించిన ఉద్దేశపూర్వక, ప్రేరేపిత దాడులను మీరు ఆకర్షించవచ్చు.
చాలా వరకు NGO ఉల్లంఘనలు అధునాతనమైనవి కావు. అవి దొంగిలించబడిన సంకేతపదం లేదా నమ్మదగిన ఇమెయిల్తో ప్రారంభమవుతాయి. ఇది ప్రోత్సాహకరంగా ఉంటుంది, ఎందుకంటే వాటికి వ్యతిరేకంగా రక్షణలు చౌకైనవి మరియు ఎక్కువగా ఉచితం.

అత్యంత ముఖ్యమైన ఐదు విషయాలు
మీరు ఈ గైడ్ నుండి ఇంకేమీ చేయకపోతే, వీటిని చేయండి. ప్రతి గంట ప్రయత్నానికి వారు ఎంత ప్రమాదాన్ని తొలగిస్తారో స్థూల క్రమంలో.
ప్రాధాన్యత చర్య ఎందుకు చాలా ముఖ్యమైనది
1 ప్రతిచోటా రెండు-కారకాల ప్రామాణీకరణను ప్రారంభించండి-దొంగిలించబడిన లేదా ఊహించిన సంకేతపదం-ఒక్కటే తగినంతగా ఉండకుండా ఆపుతుంది. ప్రతి ప్రధాన వేదికపై ఉచితం.
2 జట్టు అంతటా పాస్వర్డ్ మేనేజర్ను ఉపయోగించండి పంచుకున్న పాస్వర్డ్లు, తిరిగి ఉపయోగించిన పాస్వర్డ్లు మరియు కాగితంపై వ్రాసిన పాస్వర్డ్లను ముగించండి. సిబ్బంది వెళ్ళినప్పుడు అప్పగించడాన్ని కూడా పరిష్కరిస్తుంది.
3 ప్రజలు నిష్క్రమించినప్పుడు ప్రాప్యతను తొలగించండి మాజీ సిబ్బంది మరియు కాంట్రాక్టర్లు ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రాప్యతను నిలుపుకోవడం అత్యంత సాధారణ మరియు అత్యంత నివారించగల దుర్బలత్వాలలో ఒకటి.
4 ఫిషింగ్ గుర్తించడానికి సిబ్బందికి శిక్షణ ఇవ్వండి చాలా ఉల్లంఘనలు ఎవరైనా ఏదైనా క్లిక్ చేయడంతో ప్రారంభమవుతాయి. ఇరవై నిమిషాల శిక్షణ చాలా సాంకేతిక నియంత్రణలను అధిగమిస్తుంది.
5 మీ డేటాను బ్యాకప్ చేయండి మరియు పునరుద్ధరణ రాన్సమ్వేర్ను పరీక్షించండి మరియు ప్రమాదవశాత్తు తొలగించడం రెండూ పని చేసే బ్యాకప్తో మనుగడ సాగించగలవు. పరీక్షించని బ్యాకప్ అనేది బ్యాకప్ కాదు.

గమనించదగ్గ విషయం
ఐదుగురిలో నాలుగింటికి ఖర్చు ఏమీ లేదని గమనించండి. చిన్న ఎన్జీఓలు బలహీనంగా ఉన్న చోట భద్రతా వ్యయం చాలా అరుదు-ఆచరణ.

మీరు దావా వేయగల ఉచిత రక్షణ
Cloudflare ప్రాజెక్ట్ గెలీలియో
ప్రజా ప్రయోజన పని చేసే సంస్థలకు ఉచిత ఎంటర్ప్రైజ్-గ్రేడ్ రక్షణ- Cloudflare యొక్క చెల్లింపు వ్యాపార ప్రణాళికకు సమానం. ఇందులో మీటర్ చేయని DDoS ఉపశమనం, వెబ్ అప్లికేషన్ ఫైర్వాల్, CDN, SSL సర్టిఫికెట్లు మరియు జీరో ట్రస్ట్ యాక్సెస్ నియంత్రణలు ఉన్నాయి.
మానవ హక్కుల మద్దతు, పౌర సమాజం మరియు ప్రజాస్వామ్య మద్దతు, జర్నలిజం మరియు మీడియా మరియు కళలు మరియు సాంస్కృతిక వ్యక్తీకరణలను లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.
మీరు బహిర్గతం చేయడానికి అనుమతించకపోతే Cloudflare పాల్గొనే సంస్థలను గోప్యంగా ఉంచుతుంది.
నేరుగా దరఖాస్తు చేయండి, లేదా Cloudflare యొక్క 40 + భాగస్వామి సంస్థలలో ఒకదాని ద్వారా-భాగస్వామి మార్గం సాధారణంగా వేగంగా ఉంటుంది.
ప్రత్యేక Cloudflare ప్రాజెక్ట్ గెలీలియో గైడ్లో పూర్తిగా కవర్ చేయబడింది.
Google ప్రాజెక్ట్ షీల్డ్
వార్తా సంస్థలు, మానవ హక్కుల సంఘాలు మరియు ఎన్నికల పర్యవేక్షణ సంస్థలను లక్ష్యంగా చేసుకుని Google యొక్క సమానమైన ఉచిత DDoS రక్షణ సేవ. దానికి బదులుగా గెలీలియోతో పాటు అంచనా వేయడం విలువైనది-అర్హత అతివ్యాప్తి చెందుతుంది కానీ ఒకేలా ఉండదు, మరియు రెండింటినీ దర్యాప్తు చేయడానికి ఎటువంటి జరిమానా లేదు.
దయచేసి ధృవీకరించండి
ప్రాజెక్ట్ షీల్డ్ యొక్క ప్రస్తుత నిబంధనలు ఈ గైడ్ కోసం పరిశోధన సమయంలో ధృవీకరించబడలేదు, ఎందుకంటే దాని పేజీలు చదవగలిగే కంటెంట్ను ఆటోమేటెడ్ ఫెచింగ్కు తిరిగి ఇవ్వలేదు. ప్రస్తుతం ఏమి అందించబడుతుందో ధృవీకరించడానికి బ్రౌజర్లో projectshield.withgoogle.com ని సందర్శించండి.
లాభాపేక్షలేని సాఫ్ట్వేర్లో భద్రతను చేర్చారు
Microsoft 365 బిజినెస్ ప్రీమియం-75 శాతం లాభాపేక్షలేని తగ్గింపుతో లభిస్తుంది-అనేక ఎన్జీఓలు తాము ఇప్పటికే చెల్లిస్తున్నట్లు గుర్తించని ఎంటర్ప్రైజ్ భద్రతా లక్షణాలను కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
లాభాపేక్షలేని సంస్థల కోసం Google Workspace లో మీ డొమైన్ అంతటా అమలు చేయబడిన రెండు-కారకాల ప్రామాణీకరణతో సహా ఖాతా భద్రతా నియంత్రణలు ఉంటాయి.
మీరు రెండింటిలో దేనినైనా పట్టుకుంటే, భద్రతా లక్షణాలు ఇప్పటికే మీవి; పని కొత్తదాన్ని కొనడం కంటే వాటిని ఆన్ చేయడం.


లబ్ధిదారుల డేటాను రక్షించడం
ఇక్కడే NGO భద్రత వ్యాపార భద్రత నుండి అర్ధవంతంగా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది. వినియోగదారుల డేటాను రక్షించే సంస్థ వాణిజ్య మరియు నియంత్రణ పరిణామాలను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది. హింస నుండి ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడిన వారి గురించి, కళంకిత పరిస్థితులతో జీవిస్తున్న వ్యక్తుల గురించి లేదా వివాదాస్పద రాజకీయ సందర్భంలో కమ్యూనిటీ సభ్యుల గురించి రికార్డులను కలిగి ఉన్న సంస్థ మిమ్మల్ని విశ్వసించే ఎవరికైనా ఉల్లంఘన నేరుగా హాని కలిగించే అవకాశాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.
ఎక్కువ బరువును మోయగల ఆచరణాత్మక చర్యలుః
తక్కువ సేకరించండి. మీరు ఎన్నడూ సేకరించని డేటా లీక్ కాదు. మీ ఇన్టేక్ ఫారంలోని ప్రతి ఫీల్డ్ నిజాయితీగా ఉపయోగించబడిందా అని సమీక్షించండి.
పాత్ర ద్వారా ప్రాప్యతను పరిమితం చేయండి. ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ ప్రతిదీ చూడవలసిన అవసరం లేదు. చాలా వ్యవస్థలు దీనికి మద్దతు ఇస్తాయి మరియు చాలా సంస్థలు దీనిని ఆకృతీకరించవు.
పని అనుమతించిన చోట కేసు వివరాల నుండి గుర్తించే వివరాలను వేరు చేయండి.
డేటా ఎక్కడ నివసిస్తుందనే దాని గురించి ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా ఉండండి. వ్యక్తిగత ల్యాప్టాప్ లేదా వాట్సప్ గ్రూప్లోని స్ప్రెడ్షీట్ నిల్వ కాదు; అది బహిర్గతం.
ఏదైనా లీక్ అయితే ఏమి జరుగుతుందో ఒక ప్రణాళికను కలిగి ఉండండి-ఎవరికి చెప్పబడుతుంది, ఏ క్రమంలో, మరియు ఎలా ప్రభావితమైన ప్రజలకు తెలియజేయబడుతుంది.

భారత చట్టంపై
భారతదేశం యొక్క డిజిటల్ వ్యక్తిగత డేటా రక్షణ చట్టం, 2023 వ్యక్తిగత డేటాను నిర్వహించే సంస్థలకు బాధ్యతలను సృష్టిస్తుంది. దాని వివరణాత్మక నియమాలు మరియు అమలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్నాయి, మరియు ఈ గైడ్ ప్రస్తుత స్థితిని సంగ్రహించడానికి ప్రయత్నించదు. మీరు ఏ స్థాయిలోనూ సున్నితమైన లబ్ధిదారుల డేటాను కలిగి ఉంటే, ఇది చెక్లిస్ట్కు బదులుగా సరైన చట్టపరమైన సలహాకు విలువైనది-మరియు మీ సమ్మతి విభాగంలో దాని స్వంత కథనానికి బలమైన అభ్యర్థి.


ఒక వాస్తవిక ప్రారంభ క్రమం
1.	దేనికి ప్రాప్యత ఉందో ఆడిట్ చేయండి. ప్రతి వ్యవస్థను మరియు లాగిన్ అయిన ప్రతి వ్యక్తిని జాబితా చేయండి. ఇది సాధారణంగా మాజీ ఉద్యోగికి ఇప్పటికీ నిర్వాహక హక్కులు ఉన్నాయని సంస్థలు కనుగొన్న క్షణం.
2.	మొదట ఇమెయిల్లో రెండు కారకాల ధృవీకరణను అమలు చేయండి, తరువాత మిగతావన్నీ. ఇమెయిల్ ప్రధాన కీ-దానిని నియంత్రించే వారు మిగిలిన వాటిని రీసెట్ చేయవచ్చు.
3.	పాస్వర్డ్ నిర్వాహకుడిని దత్తత తీసుకుని, పక్షం రోజుల పాటు బృందాన్ని మార్చండి.
4.	ప్రతి క్లిష్టమైన వ్యవస్థకు రెండవ నిర్వాహకుడిని నియమించండి, కాబట్టి ఏ ఖాతా ఒక వ్యక్తిపై ఆధారపడి ఉండదు.
5.	ఇరవై నిమిషాల ఫిషింగ్ అవగాహన సెషన్ను నిర్వహించండి. వాటిని నైరూప్యంగా వివరించే బదులు నిజమైన ఉదాహరణలను చూపించండి.
6.	నిజంగా దేనినైనా పునరుద్ధరించడం ద్వారా మీ బ్యాకప్లను ధృవీకరించండి.
7.	మీ పని ప్రతికూల దృష్టిని ఆకర్షించే అవకాశం ఉంటే, ప్రాజెక్ట్ గెలీలియోకు దరఖాస్తు చేయండి.
8.	ఆఫ్బోర్డింగ్ దశలను వ్రాయండి, తద్వారా యాక్సెస్ను తొలగించడం అనేది గుర్తుంచుకునే బదులు నిత్యకృత్యంగా మారుతుంది.

త్వరిత తనిఖీ జాబితా
ప్రతి వ్యవస్థను మరియు ప్రాప్యత ఉన్న ప్రతి ఒక్కరినీ జాబితా చేయండి
ఇమెయిల్తో ప్రారంభించి రెండు-కారకాల ప్రామాణీకరణను అమలు చేయండి
జట్టు అంతటా పాస్వర్డ్ మేనేజర్ను రూపొందించండి
ప్రతి క్లిష్టమైన ఖాతాకు రెండవ నిర్వాహకుడిని నియమించండి
* వదిలిపెట్టిన ఎవరికైనా ప్రాప్యతను తొలగించండి
నిజమైన ఉదాహరణలతో ఒక చిన్న ఫిషింగ్ అవగాహన సెషన్ను నిర్వహించండి
బ్యాకప్లు మాత్రమే కాకుండా, బ్యాకప్ పునరుద్ధరణను పరీక్షించండి
మీరు ఏ లబ్ధిదారుల డేటాను సేకరిస్తున్నారో మరియు మీకు అవన్నీ అవసరమా అని సమీక్షించండి.
మీ పని ప్రతికూల దృష్టిని ఆకర్షిస్తే జెడ్ క్యూ జెడ్ క్యూ ప్రాజెక్ట్ గెలీలియోకు దరఖాస్తు చేయండి
మీ ఆఫ్ బోర్డింగ్ విధానాన్ని వ్రాయండి

మూలాలు
జెడ్ క్యూ 1 జెడ్ క్యూ ప్రాజెక్ట్ గెలీలియో జెడ్ క్యూ 0 జెడ్ క్యూ https://www.cloudflare.com/galileo/
Google ప్రాజెక్ట్ షీల్డ్ https://projectshield.withgoogle.com/
Microsoft 365 లాభాపేక్షలేని ఆఫర్లు (వ్యాపార ప్రీమియం భద్రతా లక్షణాలు) https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/nonprofits/microsoft-365

గమనికః ఈ గైడ్లోని ఆచరణాత్మక భద్రతా మార్గదర్శకత్వం ఏ ఒక్క ఉదహరించబడిన మూలం కంటే బాగా స్థిరపడిన వృత్తిపరమైన అభ్యాసాన్ని ప్రతిబింబిస్తుంది. Cloudflare మరియు Microsoft వివరాలు పై పేజీల నుండి ధృవీకరించబడ్డాయి. ప్రాజెక్ట్ షీల్డ్ యొక్క నిబంధనలు మరియు ప్రస్తుత DPDP చట్టం నియమాల స్థితి పరిశోధన సమయంలో ధృవీకరించబడలేదు మరియు నేరుగా తనిఖీ చేయాలి.
bodies.bn:
এনজিওগুলির জন্য সাইবার নিরাপত্তা

আপনার সাইট, আপনার ডেটা এবং আপনার কর্মীদের অ্যাকাউন্টগুলি সুরক্ষিত করা
এনজিও-র জন্য প্রস্তুত। আগস্ট 2026

এনজিওদের কেন লক্ষ্যবস্তু করা হয়
অলাভজনক সংস্থাগুলিকে তিনটি কারণে আক্রমণ করা হয়, এবং এগুলির কোনওটিই নয় যে আক্রমণকারীরা আপনার মিশন অপছন্দ করে। প্রথমত, আপনার কাছে মূল্যবান তথ্য রয়েছে-দাতাদের অর্থ প্রদানের বিবরণ, সুবিধাভোগী রেকর্ড, কখনও কখনও দুর্বল ব্যক্তিদের সম্পর্কে সংবেদনশীল তথ্য। দ্বিতীয়ত, আপনার তুলনামূলক আকারের ব্যবসার তুলনায় দুর্বল প্রতিরক্ষা রয়েছে, যা আপনাকে একটি দক্ষ লক্ষ্যবস্তু করে তোলে। তৃতীয়ত, যদি আপনার কাজ মানবাধিকার, সাংবাদিকতা, নির্বাচন বা প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতামূলক নীতি স্পর্শ করে, তবে আপনি ইচ্ছাকৃত, অনুপ্রাণিত আক্রমণগুলি আকর্ষণ করতে পারেন যা আপনাকে নীরব করার উদ্দেশ্যে।
বেশিরভাগ NGO লঙ্ঘন পরিশীলিত নয়। এগুলি একটি চুরি করা পাসওয়ার্ড বা একটি বিশ্বাসযোগ্য ইমেল দিয়ে শুরু হয়। এটি উৎসাহজনক, কারণ এগুলির বিরুদ্ধে প্রতিরক্ষা সস্তা এবং মূলত বিনামূল্যে।

যে পাঁচটি বিষয় সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ
আপনি যদি এই গাইড থেকে আর কিছু না করেন, তবে এগুলি করুন। মোটামুটিভাবে তারা প্রতি ঘন্টায় কতটা ঝুঁকি সরিয়ে দেয় তার ক্রমানুসারে।
অগ্রাধিকার পদক্ষেপ কেন এটি সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ
1 সর্বত্র দ্বি-উপাদান প্রমাণীকরণ চালু করুন সবচেয়ে সাধারণ আক্রমণ-একটি চুরি করা বা অনুমান করা পাসওয়ার্ড-নিজেরাই যথেষ্ট হওয়া থেকে বিরত রাখে। প্রতিটি প্রধান প্ল্যাটফর্মে বিনামূল্যে।
2 দল জুড়ে একটি পাসওয়ার্ড ম্যানেজার ব্যবহার করুন ভাগ করা পাসওয়ার্ড, পুনরায় ব্যবহৃত পাসওয়ার্ড এবং কাগজে লেখা পাসওয়ার্ডগুলি শেষ করুন। এছাড়াও কর্মীরা চলে যাওয়ার সময় হস্তান্তরের সমাধান করে।
3 লোকেরা চলে গেলে প্রবেশাধিকার সরিয়ে ফেলুন প্রাক্তন কর্মী এবং ঠিকাদাররা সরাসরি প্রবেশাধিকার বজায় রাখা সবচেয়ে সাধারণ এবং সবচেয়ে এড়ানো যায় এমন দুর্বলতাগুলির মধ্যে একটি।
4 কর্মীদের ফিশিং শনাক্ত করতে প্রশিক্ষণ দিন বেশিরভাগ লঙ্ঘন শুরু হয় কেউ কিছু ক্লিক করার মাধ্যমে। কুড়ি মিনিটের প্রশিক্ষণ বেশিরভাগ প্রযুক্তিগত নিয়ন্ত্রণকে পরাজিত করে।
5 আপনার ডেটা ব্যাক আপ করুন, এবং পুনরুদ্ধার র্যানসমওয়্যার পরীক্ষা করুন এবং দুর্ঘটনাক্রমে মুছে ফেলা উভয়ই একটি কার্যকরী ব্যাকআপের সাথে বেঁচে থাকতে পারে। একটি অ-পরীক্ষিত ব্যাকআপ কোনও ব্যাকআপ নয়।

লক্ষণীয়।

সুবিধাভোগীদের তথ্য রক্ষা করা
এখানেই NGO নিরাপত্তা ব্যবসায়িক নিরাপত্তা থেকে অর্থপূর্ণভাবে পৃথক। গ্রাহকের তথ্য রক্ষা করে এমন একটি সংস্থা বাণিজ্যিক ও নিয়ন্ত্রণমূলক পরিণতির মুখোমুখি হয়। সহিংসতায় বেঁচে যাওয়া, কলঙ্কিত পরিস্থিতিতে বসবাসকারী মানুষ বা প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতামূলক রাজনৈতিক প্রেক্ষাপটে সম্প্রদায়ের সদস্যদের সম্পর্কে রেকর্ড ধারণকারী একটি সংস্থা এমন সম্ভাবনার মুখোমুখি হয় যে একটি লঙ্ঘন আপনাকে বিশ্বাস করে এমন কাউকে সরাসরি ক্ষতিগ্রস্থ করে।

ভূমিকা অনুসারে প্রবেশাধিকার সীমাবদ্ধ করুন। প্রত্যেকেরই সবকিছু দেখার প্রয়োজন নেই। বেশিরভাগ সিস্টেম এটি সমর্থন করে এবং বেশিরভাগ সংস্থা এটি কনফিগার করে না।

তথ্য কোথায় থাকে সে সম্পর্কে সচেতন থাকুন। ব্যক্তিগত ল্যাপটপ বা হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ গ্রুপের একটি স্প্রেডশিট স্টোরেজ নয়; এটি এক্সপোজার।

ভারতীয় আইন সম্পর্কে
ভারতের ডিজিটাল ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য সুরক্ষা আইন, 2023 ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য পরিচালনাকারী সংস্থাগুলির জন্য বাধ্যবাধকতা তৈরি করে। এর বিস্তারিত নিয়ম এবং প্রয়োগগুলি বিকশিত হচ্ছে, এবং এই গাইডটি বর্তমান অবস্থানের সংক্ষিপ্তসার করার চেষ্টা করে না। আপনি যদি কোনও মাত্রায় সংবেদনশীল সুবিধাভোগী তথ্য ধারণ করেন, তবে এটি একটি চেকলিস্টের পরিবর্তে যথাযথ আইনি পরামর্শের যোগ্য-এবং আপনার সম্মতি বিভাগে নিজস্ব নিবন্ধের জন্য একটি শক্তিশালী প্রার্থী।


একটি বাস্তবসম্মত শুরুর ক্রম
1.	নিরীক্ষা করুন কার কি অ্যাক্সেস আছে। প্রতিটি সিস্টেম এবং লগইন সহ প্রতিটি ব্যক্তির তালিকা করুন। সাধারণত এই মুহুর্তে সংস্থাগুলি আবিষ্কার করে যে একজন প্রাক্তন কর্মচারীর এখনও প্রশাসকের অধিকার রয়েছে।
2.	প্রথমে ইমেইলে দ্বি-উপাদান প্রমাণীকরণ প্রয়োগ করুন, তারপর বাকি সবকিছু। ইমেল হল প্রধান কী-যে এটি নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে সে বাকিটা পুনরায় সেট করতে পারে।
3.	একজন পাসওয়ার্ড ম্যানেজারকে গ্রহণ করুন এবং এক পাক্ষিকের মধ্যে দলটিকে স্থানান্তরিত করুন।
4.	প্রতিটি সমালোচনামূলক ব্যবস্থার জন্য একজন দ্বিতীয় প্রশাসক নিয়োগ করুন, যাতে কোনও অ্যাকাউন্টই একজন ব্যক্তির উপর নির্ভর করে না।
5.	বিশ মিনিটের একটি ফিশিং সচেতনতা অধিবেশন চালান। সেগুলিকে বিমূর্তভাবে বর্ণনা করার পরিবর্তে প্রকৃত উদাহরণ দেখান।
6.	প্রকৃতপক্ষে কিছু পুনরুদ্ধার করে আপনার ব্যাকআপগুলি যাচাই করুন।
7.	যদি আপনার কাজ প্রতিকূল দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করতে পারে, তাহলে Cloudflare প্রকল্প গ্যালিলিওতে আবেদন করুন।
8.	অফবোর্ডিং ধাপগুলি লিখে রাখুন যাতে অ্যাক্সেস সরিয়ে ফেলা মনে রাখার পরিবর্তে রুটিন হয়ে যায়।

શા માટે એન. જી. ઓ. ને નિશાન બનાવવામાં આવે છે
બિનનફાકારક સંસ્થાઓ પર ત્રણ કારણોસર હુમલો કરવામાં આવે છે, અને તેમાંથી કોઈ પણ કારણ એ નથી કે હુમલાખોરો તમારા મિશનને નાપસંદ કરે છે. પ્રથમ, તમારી પાસે મૂલ્યવાન માહિતી છે-દાતા ચુકવણીની વિગતો, લાભાર્થીના રેકોર્ડ, ક્યારેક નબળા લોકો વિશે સંવેદનશીલ માહિતી. બીજું, તમારી પાસે તુલનાત્મક કદના વ્યવસાય કરતાં નબળા સંરક્ષણ હોય છે, જે તમને કાર્યક્ષમ લક્ષ્ય બનાવે છે. ત્રીજું, જો તમારું કાર્ય માનવાધિકાર, પત્રકારત્વ, ચૂંટણીઓ અથવા લડાયેલી નીતિને સ્પર્શે છે, તો તમે ઇરાદાપૂર્વક, પ્રેરિત હુમલાઓને આકર્ષિત કરી શકો છો જેનો હેતુ તમને ચૂપ કરવાનો છે.
મોટા ભાગના NGO ભંગ વ્યવહારદક્ષ નથી. તેઓ ચોરાયેલા પાસવર્ડ અથવા વિશ્વાસપાત્ર ઇમેઇલથી શરૂ થાય છે. તે પ્રોત્સાહક છે, કારણ કે તે સામેના સંરક્ષણ સસ્તા અને મોટા ભાગે મફત છે.

પાંચ વસ્તુઓ જે સૌથી વધુ મહત્વની છે
જો તમે આ માર્ગદર્શિકામાંથી બીજું કશું ન કરો, તો આ કરો. તેઓ દર કલાકના પ્રયત્નોમાં કેટલું જોખમ દૂર કરે છે તેના રફ ક્રમમાં.
પ્રાધાન્યતા ક્રિયા શા માટે તે સૌથી વધુ મહત્ત્વની છે
1 દરેક જગ્યાએ દ્વિ-પરિબળ પ્રમાણીકરણ ચાલુ કરો એક સૌથી સામાન્ય હુમલો-ચોરાયેલો અથવા અનુમાનિત પાસવર્ડ-તેના પોતાના પર પૂરતો થવાથી અટકાવે છે. દરેક મુખ્ય પ્લેટફોર્મ પર મફત.
2 સમગ્ર ટીમમાં પાસવર્ડ મેનેજરનો ઉપયોગ કરો શેર કરેલા પાસવર્ડ્સ, ફરીથી ઉપયોગમાં લેવાતા પાસવર્ડ્સ અને કાગળ પર લખેલા પાસવર્ડ્સને સમાપ્ત કરે છે. જ્યારે સ્ટાફ જાય ત્યારે સોંપણી પણ ઉકેલે છે.
3 જ્યારે લોકો બહાર નીકળે ત્યારે પ્રવેશ દૂર કરો ભૂતપૂર્વ સ્ટાફ અને ઠેકેદારોએ જીવંત પ્રવેશ જાળવી રાખવો એ સૌથી સામાન્ય અને સૌથી વધુ ટાળી શકાય તેવી જોખમોમાંથી એક છે.
4 ફિશિંગને ઓળખવા માટે કર્મચારીઓને તાલીમ આપો મોટાભાગના ઉલ્લંઘનની શરૂઆત કોઈ વ્યક્તિ કંઈક ક્લિક કરવાથી થાય છે. વીસ મિનિટની તાલીમ મોટાભાગના તકનીકી નિયંત્રણોને હરાવે છે.
5 તમારા ડેટાનો બેકઅપ લો, અને રિસ્ટોર રેન્સમવેરનું પરીક્ષણ કરો અને આકસ્મિક રીતે કાઢી નાંખવું બંને કાર્યરત બેકઅપ સાથે ટકી શકે છે. ચકાસાયેલ બેકઅપ એ બેકઅપ નથી.

નોંધ લેવા યોગ્ય
નોંધ લો કે પાંચમાંથી ચારની કિંમત કંઈ નથી. સુરક્ષા ખર્ચ ભાગ્યે જ થાય છે જ્યાં નાના એનજીઓ સૌથી નબળા હોય છે-પ્રથા છે.

Cloudflare પ્રોજેક્ટ ગેલિલિયો
જાહેર હિતનું કામ કરતી સંસ્થાઓ માટે મફત એન્ટરપ્રાઇઝ-ગ્રેડ રક્ષણ-જે Cloudflare ની પેઇડ બિઝનેસ પ્લાનની સમકક્ષ છે. તેમાં અનમીટર્ડ ડીડીઓએસ મિટિગેશન, વેબ એપ્લિકેશન ફાયરવોલ, સીડીએન, એસએસએલ પ્રમાણપત્રો અને ઝીરો ટ્રસ્ટ એક્સેસ કંટ્રોલ્સનો સમાવેશ થાય છે.
માનવ અધિકારોની હિમાયત, નાગરિક સમાજ અને લોકશાહી સમર્થન, પત્રકારત્વ અને મીડિયા, અને કળા અને સાંસ્કૃતિક અભિવ્યક્તિને ધ્યાનમાં રાખીને.
જ્યાં સુધી તમે જાહેરાતની મંજૂરી ન આપો ત્યાં સુધી Cloudflare સહભાગી સંસ્થાઓને ગુપ્ત રાખે છે.
સીધા અરજી કરો, અથવા Cloudflare ની 40 + ભાગીદાર સંસ્થાઓમાંથી એક દ્વારા-ભાગીદાર માર્ગ સામાન્ય રીતે ઝડપી હોય છે.
અલગ Cloudflare પ્રોજેક્ટ ગેલિલિયો માર્ગદર્શિકામાં સંપૂર્ણ રીતે આવરી લેવામાં આવ્યું છે.

ઝેડ. ક્યુ. ઝેડ. ક્યુ. ની સમકક્ષ મફત ડી. ડી. ઓ. એસ. સુરક્ષા સેવા, સમાચાર સંસ્થાઓ, માનવાધિકાર જૂથો અને ચૂંટણી-દેખરેખ સંસ્થાઓને ધ્યાનમાં રાખીને. તેના બદલે ગેલિલિયો સાથે મૂલ્યાંકન કરવા યોગ્ય-પાત્રતા ઓવરલેપ થાય છે પરંતુ તે સમાન નથી, અને બંનેની તપાસ માટે કોઈ દંડ નથી.
મહેરબાની કરીને ચકાસો
પ્રોજેક્ટ શીલ્ડની હાલની શરતો આ માર્ગદર્શિકા માટે સંશોધન દરમિયાન ચકાસી શકાતી નથી, કારણ કે તેના પૃષ્ઠો વાંચી શકાય તેવી સામગ્રીને સ્વચાલિત રીતે લાવવા માટે પરત કરતા નથી. હાલમાં શું ઓફર કરવામાં આવે છે તેની પુષ્ટિ કરવા માટે બ્રાઉઝરમાં projectshield.withgoogle.com ની મુલાકાત લો.
બિનનફાકારક સોફ્ટવેરમાં સમાવિષ્ટ સુરક્ષા
Microsoft 365 બિઝનેસ પ્રીમિયમ-જે 75 ટકા બિનનફાકારક ડિસ્કાઉન્ટમાં ઉપલબ્ધ છે-તેમાં એન્ટરપ્રાઇઝ સુરક્ષા સુવિધાઓનો સમાવેશ થાય છે જે ઘણા એનજીઓને ખ્યાલ નથી આવતો કે તેઓ પહેલેથી જ ચૂકવણી કરી રહ્યા છે.
બિનનફાકારક સંસ્થાઓ માટે Google Workspace માં એકાઉન્ટ સુરક્ષા નિયંત્રણોનો સમાવેશ થાય છે, જેમાં તમારા ડોમેનમાં લાગુ કરાયેલ બે-પરિબળ પ્રમાણીકરણનો સમાવેશ થાય છે.
જો તમે બંનેમાંથી કોઈ એકને પકડી રાખો છો, તો સુરક્ષા સુવિધાઓ પહેલેથી જ તમારી છે; કાર્ય કંઈક નવું ખરીદવાને બદલે તેને ચાલુ કરવાનું છે.


લાભાર્થીની માહિતીની સુરક્ષા
આ તે જગ્યા છે જ્યાં NGO સુરક્ષા વ્યવસાયિક સુરક્ષાથી અર્થપૂર્ણ રીતે અલગ પડે છે. ગ્રાહક ડેટાની સુરક્ષા કરતી કંપનીને વ્યાવસાયિક અને નિયમનકારી પરિણામોનો સામનો કરવો પડે છે. હિંસામાંથી બચેલા લોકો, કલંકિત પરિસ્થિતિઓમાં જીવતા લોકો અથવા વિવાદિત રાજકીય સંદર્ભમાં સમુદાયના સભ્યો વિશે રેકોર્ડ ધરાવતી સંસ્થાને એવી સંભાવનાનો સામનો કરવો પડે છે કે ઉલ્લંઘન તમારા પર વિશ્વાસ કરનાર વ્યક્તિને સીધું નુકસાન પહોંચાડે છે.
મોટાભાગના વજન ધરાવતા વ્યવહારુ પગલાંઃ
ઓછું એકત્રિત કરો. તમે ક્યારેય એકત્રિત કરેલો ડેટા લીક ન થઈ શકે. તમારા ઇન્ટેક ફોર્મ પરનું દરેક ક્ષેત્ર ખરેખર ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયું છે કે કેમ તેની સમીક્ષા કરો.
ભૂમિકા દ્વારા ઍક્સેસને મર્યાદિત કરો. દરેકને બધું જોવાની જરૂર નથી. મોટાભાગની સિસ્ટમો આને સમર્થન આપે છે અને મોટાભાગની સંસ્થાઓ તેને રૂપરેખાંકિત કરતી નથી.
જ્યાં કામ તેને મંજૂરી આપે છે તે કેસની વિગતોમાંથી ઓળખની વિગતોને અલગ કરો.
માહિતી ક્યાં રહે છે તે વિશે ઇરાદાપૂર્વક વિચારો. વ્યક્તિગત લેપટોપ અથવા વ્હોટ્સઅપ જૂથ પરની સ્પ્રેડશીટ સંગ્રહ નથી; તે એક્સપોઝર છે.
જો કંઈક લીક થાય તો શું થાય છે તેની યોજના બનાવો-કોને કહેવામાં આવે છે, કયા ક્રમમાં અને અસરગ્રસ્ત લોકોને કેવી રીતે જાણ કરવામાં આવે છે.

ભારતીય કાયદા વિશે
ભારતનો ડિજિટલ પર્સનલ ડેટા પ્રોટેક્શન એક્ટ, 2023 વ્યક્તિગત ડેટાને સંભાળતી સંસ્થાઓ માટે જવાબદારીઓ બનાવે છે. તેના વિગતવાર નિયમો અને અમલીકરણ વિકસિત થઈ રહ્યા છે, અને આ માર્ગદર્શિકા વર્તમાન સ્થિતિનો સારાંશ આપવાનો પ્રયાસ કરતી નથી. જો તમે કોઈપણ સ્તરે સંવેદનશીલ લાભાર્થી ડેટા ધરાવો છો, તો આ ચેકલિસ્ટને બદલે યોગ્ય કાનૂની સલાહને યોગ્ય છે-અને તમારી પાલન શ્રેણીમાં તેના પોતાના લેખ માટે મજબૂત ઉમેદવાર છે.


એક વાસ્તવિક શરૂઆતનો ક્રમ
1.	જેની પાસે કઈ વસ્તુની ઍક્સેસ છે તેનું ઓડિટ કરો. દરેક સિસ્ટમ અને લોગિન ધરાવતી દરેક વ્યક્તિની યાદી બનાવો. સામાન્ય રીતે આ તે ક્ષણ હોય છે જ્યારે સંસ્થાઓને ખબર પડે છે કે ભૂતપૂર્વ કર્મચારી પાસે હજુ પણ વહીવટના અધિકારો છે.
2.	પહેલા ઇમેઇલ પર દ્વિ-પરિબળ પ્રમાણીકરણ લાગુ કરો, પછી બીજું બધું. ઇમેઇલ એ મુખ્ય કી છે-જે તેને નિયંત્રિત કરે છે તે બાકીનાને રીસેટ કરી શકે છે.
3.	પાસવર્ડ મેનેજરને અપનાવો અને એક પખવાડિયામાં ટીમને સ્થાનાંતરિત કરો.
4.	દરેક નિર્ણાયક પ્રણાલી માટે બીજા સંચાલકની નિમણૂક કરો, જેથી કોઈ પણ ખાતું એક વ્યક્તિ પર નિર્ભર ન રહે.
5.	વીસ મિનિટનું ફિશિંગ જાગૃતિ સત્ર ચલાવો. તેમને અમૂર્ત રીતે વર્ણવવાને બદલે વાસ્તવિક ઉદાહરણો બતાવો.
6.	વાસ્તવમાં કંઈક પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરીને તમારા બેકઅપની ચકાસણી કરો.
7.	જો તમારું કામ પ્રતિકૂળ ધ્યાન આકર્ષિત કરે તેવી શક્યતા છે, તો Cloudflare પ્રોજેક્ટ ગેલિલિયો પર અરજી કરો.
8.	ઓફબોર્ડિંગ પગલાંઓ લખો જેથી યાદ રાખવાને બદલે ઍક્સેસને દૂર કરવી નિયમિત બની જાય.

ઝડપી ચેકલિસ્ટ
દરેક સિસ્ટમ અને જેની પાસે ઍક્સેસ છે તે દરેકની યાદી બનાવો
ઇ-મેઇલથી શરૂ કરીને દ્વિ-પરિબળ પ્રમાણીકરણ લાગુ કરો
સમગ્ર ટીમમાં પાસવર્ડ મેનેજરને રોલ આઉટ કરો
દરેક મહત્વપૂર્ણ ખાતા માટે બીજા વહીવટકર્તાની નિમણૂક કરો
જે કોઈએ છોડી દીધું હોય તેના માટે ઍક્સેસને દૂર કરો
વાસ્તવિક ઉદાહરણો સાથે ટૂંકું ફિશિંગ જાગૃતિ સત્ર ચલાવો
બેકઅપ રિસ્ટોરની ચકાસણી કરો, માત્ર બેકઅપ અસ્તિત્વમાં નથી
તમે કયા લાભાર્થીની માહિતી એકત્રિત કરો છો અને તમને તે બધાની જરૂર છે કે કેમ તેની સમીક્ષા કરો.
જો તમારું કામ પ્રતિકૂળ ધ્યાન આકર્ષિત કરે તો Cloudflare પ્રોજેક્ટ ગેલિલિયો પર અરજી કરો
તમારી ઓફબોર્ડિંગ પ્રક્રિયા લખો

સ્ત્રોતો
Cloudflare પ્રોજેક્ટ ગેલિલિયો https://www.cloudflare.com/galileo/
Google પ્રોજેક્ટ શીલ્ડ https://projectshield.withgoogle.com/
Microsoft 365 બિનનફાકારક ઓફર (વ્યવસાય પ્રીમિયમ સુરક્ષા સુવિધાઓ) https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/nonprofits/microsoft-365

નોંધઃ આ માર્ગદર્શિકામાં વ્યવહારુ સુરક્ષા માર્ગદર્શન કોઈપણ એક ટાંકવામાં આવેલા સ્રોતને બદલે સારી રીતે સ્થાપિત વ્યાવસાયિક પ્રથાને પ્રતિબિંબિત કરે છે. ઉપરના પૃષ્ઠો પરથી Cloudflare અને Microsoft વિગતોની પુષ્ટિ કરવામાં આવી છે. પ્રોજેક્ટ શીલ્ડની શરતો અને DPDP કાયદાના નિયમોની વર્તમાન સ્થિતિ સંશોધન દરમિયાન ચકાસવામાં આવી ન હતી અને તેની સીધી તપાસ થવી જોઈએ.

ಎನ್. ಜಿ. ಓ. ಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಸೈಬರ್ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟಿ

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಾಲತಾಣ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಖಾತೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು.
ಎನ್. ಜಿ. ಓ. ಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆ | ಆಗಸ್ಟ್ 2026

ಎನ್ಜಿಒಗಳು ಏಕೆ ಗುರಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ
ಲಾಭರಹಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೂರು ಕಾರಣಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ದಾಳಿ ನಡೆಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೂ ಆಕ್ರಮಣಕಾರರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉದ್ದೇಶವನ್ನು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದಾಗಿ, ನೀವು ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತವಾದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತೀರಿ-ದಾನಿ ಪಾವತಿ ವಿವರಗಳು, ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು, ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ದುರ್ಬಲ ಜನರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ. ಎರಡನೆಯದಾಗಿ, ನೀವು ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕ ಗಾತ್ರದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ದುರ್ಬಲ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತೀರಿ, ಇದು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂರನೆಯದಾಗಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಮಾನವ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು, ಪತ್ರಿಕೋದ್ಯಮ, ಚುನಾವಣೆಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ನೀತಿಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಿದರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಮೌನಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ನೀವು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕ, ಪ್ರೇರಿತ ದಾಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದು.
ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ NGO ಉಲ್ಲಂಘನೆಗಳು ಅತ್ಯಾಧುನಿಕವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವು ಕಳುವಾದ ಗುಪ್ತಪದ ಅಥವಾ ಮನವರಿಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಇಮೇಲ್ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹದಾಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅವುಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧದ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳು ಅಗ್ಗವಾಗಿವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿವೆ.

ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ಐದು ವಿಷಯಗಳು
ನೀವು ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಏನನ್ನೂ ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಂಟೆಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಕ್ಕೆ ಅವರು ಎಷ್ಟು ಅಪಾಯವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಸ್ಥೂಲ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ.
ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮ-ಇದು ಏಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ
1 ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಎರಡು ಅಂಶಗಳ ದೃಢೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾದ ದಾಳಿ-ಕಳುವಾದ ಅಥವಾ ಊಹಿಸಲಾದ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್-ತನ್ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ತಾನೇ ಸಾಕಾಗುವುದನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವೇದಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿದೆ.
2 ತಂಡದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ಗಳು, ಮರುಬಳಕೆಯ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬರೆದ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊನೆಗೊಳಿಸಿ. ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಹೊರಟುಹೋದಾಗ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರವನ್ನು ಸಹ ಪರಿಹರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
3 ಜನರು ಹೊರಹೋದಾಗ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿ ಮಾಜಿ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗುತ್ತಿಗೆದಾರರು ನೇರ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ದೋಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ.
4 ಫಿಶಿಂಗ್ ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಗೆ ತರಬೇತಿ ನೀಡಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಉಲ್ಲಂಘನೆಗಳು ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಏನನ್ನಾದರೂ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ ಮಾಡುವುದರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷಗಳ ತರಬೇತಿಯು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
5 ನಿಮ್ಮ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಪುನಃಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲು ರಾನ್ಸಮ್ವೇರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅಳಿಸುವುದು ಎರಡೂ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರತ ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್ನಿಂದ ಬದುಕುಳಿಯಬಲ್ಲವು. ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸದ ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್ ಒಂದು ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್ ಅಲ್ಲ.

ಗಮನಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಸಂಗತಿ.
ಐದರಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಏನೂ ವೆಚ್ಚವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಿ. ಸಣ್ಣ ಎನ್ಜಿಒಗಳು ದುರ್ಬಲವಾಗಿರುವಲ್ಲಿ ಭದ್ರತಾ ವೆಚ್ಚವು ವಿರಳವಾಗಿದೆ-ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವು.

ನೀವು ಹಕ್ಕು ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಉಚಿತ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ
Cloudflare ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೋ
ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಹಿತಾಸಕ್ತಿಯ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಉದ್ಯಮ-ದರ್ಜೆಯ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ-ಇದು Cloudflare ನ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ ಸಮನಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗದ ಡಿಡಿಒಎಸ್ ತಗ್ಗಿಸುವಿಕೆ, ವೆಬ್ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಫೈರ್ವಾಲ್, ಸಿಡಿಎನ್, ಎಸ್ಎಸ್ಎಲ್ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಝೀರೋ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.
ಮಾನವ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಪರ ವಕಾಲತ್ತು, ನಾಗರಿಕ ಸಮಾಜ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ಬೆಂಬಲ, ಪತ್ರಿಕೋದ್ಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, ಮತ್ತು ಕಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
ನೀವು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸಲು ಅನುಮತಿಸದ ಹೊರತು ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು Cloudflare ಗೌಪ್ಯವಾಗಿರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಅಥವಾ Cloudflare ನ 40 + ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ-ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಮಾರ್ಗವು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ Cloudflare ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೋ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಆವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
Google ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಶೀಲ್ಡ್
ಸುದ್ದಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು, ಮಾನವ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಚುನಾವಣಾ-ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣಾ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು Google ನ ಸಮಾನವಾದ ಉಚಿತ ಡಿ. ಡಿ. ಓ. ಎಸ್. ರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಸೇವೆ. ಅದರ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೊ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ-ಅರ್ಹತೆಯು ಅತಿಕ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ಒಂದೇ ಆಗಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ತನಿಖೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ದಂಡವಿಲ್ಲ.
ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ
ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಶೀಲ್ಡ್ನ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದರ ಪುಟಗಳು ಓದಬಲ್ಲ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ಪಡೆಯುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಏನು ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆಯೆಂದು ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲು ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ನಲ್ಲಿ projectshield.withgoogle.com ಗೆ ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡಿ.
ಲಾಭರಹಿತ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಭದ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ
Microsoft 365 ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ-75 ಪ್ರತಿಶತ ಲಾಭರಹಿತ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ-ಉದ್ಯಮ ಭದ್ರತಾ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ, ಅನೇಕ ಎನ್ಜಿಒಗಳು ತಾವು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಪಾವತಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿದಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
ಲಾಭರಹಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ Google Workspace ನಿಮ್ಮ ಡೊಮೇನ್ನಾದ್ಯಂತ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಎರಡು ಅಂಶಗಳ ದೃಢೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಂತೆ ಖಾತೆಯ ಭದ್ರತಾ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.
ನೀವು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಹಿಡಿದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದರೆ, ಭದ್ರತಾ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ನಿಮ್ಮದಾಗಿವೆ; ಹೊಸದನ್ನು ಖರೀದಿಸುವ ಬದಲು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಆನ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ.


ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಗಳ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು
ಇಲ್ಲಿ NGO ಭದ್ರತೆಯು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಭದ್ರತೆಗಿಂತ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಭಿನ್ನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ಕಂಪನಿಯು ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಿಂಸಾಚಾರದಿಂದ ಬದುಕುಳಿದವರು, ಕಳಂಕಿತ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುವ ಜನರು ಅಥವಾ ವಿವಾದಾತ್ಮಕ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಸದಸ್ಯರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯು ಉಲ್ಲಂಘನೆಯು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ನಂಬಿದ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ನೇರ ಹಾನಿಯನ್ನುಂಟುಮಾಡುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ತೂಕವನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುವ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳುಃ
ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ. ನೀವು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವು ಸೋರಿಕೆಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಇನ್ಟೇಕ್ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಬಳಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
ಪಾತ್ರದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಿಸಿ. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ನೋಡಬೇಕಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಸಂರಚಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
ಕೆಲಸವು ಅನುಮತಿಸುವ ಕೇಸ್ ವಿವರಗಳಿಂದ ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಿಸಿ.
ಡೇಟಾ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿರಿ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಲ್ಯಾಪ್ಟಾಪ್ ಅಥವಾ ವಾಟ್ಸ್ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಗ್ರೂಪ್ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸ್ಪ್ರೆಡ್ಶೀಟ್ ಶೇಖರಣೆಯಲ್ಲ; ಅದು ಬಹಿರಂಗವಾಗಿದೆ.
ಏನಾದರೂ ಸೋರಿಕೆಯಾದರೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರಿ-ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಯಾವ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಾಧಿತ ಜನರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಾನೂನಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ
ಭಾರತದ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2023 ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟುಪಾಡುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ವಿವರವಾದ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜಾರಿಗಳು ವಿಕಸನಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿವೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನೀವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಇದು ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾಪಟ್ಟಿಗಿಂತ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆಗೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ-ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಸರಣೆ ವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಲೇಖನಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಬಲ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.


ಒಂದು ವಾಸ್ತವಿಕ ಆರಂಭದ ಅನುಕ್ರಮ
1.	ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶವಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ. ಇದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಮಾಜಿ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿಗೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕ್ಷಣವಾಗಿದೆ.
2.	ಮೊದಲು ಇ-ಮೇಲ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಅಂಶಗಳ ದೃಢೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಉಳಿದೆಲ್ಲವೂ. ಇ-ಮೇಲ್ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕೀಲಿಯಾಗಿದೆ-ಅದನ್ನು ಯಾರು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೋ ಅವರು ಉಳಿದದ್ದನ್ನು ಮರುಹೊಂದಿಸಬಹುದು.
3.	ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹದಿನೈದು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಂಡವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರಿಸಿ.
4.	ಪ್ರತಿ ನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಎರಡನೇ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕರನ್ನು ನೇಮಿಸಿ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಖಾತೆಯು ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.
5.	ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷಗಳ ಫಿಶಿಂಗ್ ಜಾಗೃತಿ ಅಧಿವೇಶನವನ್ನು ನಡೆಸಿ. ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಅಮೂರ್ತವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಬದಲು ನೈಜ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿ.
6.	ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಏನನ್ನಾದರೂ ಮರುಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಅಪ್ಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
7.	ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಪ್ರತಿಕೂಲ ಗಮನವನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯಿದ್ದರೆ, ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೊಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
8.	ಆಫ್ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕುವುದು ನೆನಪಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಬದಲು ವಾಡಿಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ತ್ವರಿತ ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾಪಟ್ಟಿ
ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ
ಇ-ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ ಎರಡು ಅಂಶಗಳ ದೃಢೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ
ತಂಡದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಪಾಸ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ ಅನ್ನು ರೋಲ್ ಔಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ
ಪ್ರತಿ ನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಎರಡನೇ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕನನ್ನು ನೇಮಿಸಿ
* ಹೊರಟುಹೋದ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿ
ನಿಜವಾದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಫಿಶಿಂಗ್ ಜಾಗೃತಿ ಅಧಿವೇಶನವನ್ನು ನಡೆಸಿ
ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಅಪ್ಗಳು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಅಪ್ ಮರುಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ
ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮಗೆ ಇವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಪ್ರತಿಕೂಲ ಗಮನವನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆದರೆ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೋದ Cloudflare ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಫ್ ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

ಮೂಲಗಳು
Cloudflare ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಗೆಲಿಲಿಯೋ https://www.cloudflare.com/galileo/
Google ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಶೀಲ್ಡ್ https://projectshield.withgoogle.com/
Microsoft 365 ಲಾಭರಹಿತ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳು (ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಭದ್ರತಾ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳು) https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/nonprofits/microsoft-365

ಗಮನಿಸಿಃ ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಭದ್ರತಾ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಒಂದು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸಲಾದ ಮೂಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿತವಾದ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೇಲಿನ ಪುಟಗಳಿಂದ Cloudflare ಮತ್ತು Microsoft ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಶೀಲ್ಡ್ನ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪಿಡಿಪಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯ ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬೇಕು.

TECHSOUP & GOODSTACK

A Catalog of Offers Available to NGOs
Prepared for NGOs |  August 2026

How to Use This Document
TechSoup and Goodstack are two independent platforms that verify a nonprofit's eligibility and then unlock free or discounted access to a range of corporate products. This document lists what each platform is known to offer, organized so you can quickly see which tools are worth registering for. Where an exact discount percentage or amount was confirmed, it's listed; where a platform only names a partner without publishing specifics, that's noted so you know to check the live offer page.

Goodstack — Confirmed Offers
Goodstack combines nonprofit verification with its own discount marketplace. Once your organization is verified, the following partner offers are listed on its site:
Partner / Product	Offer	Notes
DocuSign	30–50% off select products and license types	Applies within DocuSign's agreement-management product suite
Zoom	Up to 50% off select products	Discounted access to Zoom's communication tools
OpenAI (ChatGPT)	Discounted pricing (amount not published)	Covers ChatGPT Team and ChatGPT Enterprise plans
Adobe Acrobat Pro	Nonprofit program (“Less paperwork. More impact.”)	PDF and e-signature tools; discount amount not published
Asana	50% off Starter and Advanced plans	Requires 501(c)(3) or equivalent verified nonprofit status; public libraries also eligible
Google for Nonprofits	Free access to Ad Grants, Workspace, YouTube Nonprofit Program, Maps credits	Goodstack is Google's confirmed validation partner — see our separate Google for Nonprofits guide
TikTok, Atlassian, Canva	Funding/discount programs (details not published on Goodstack's own page)	Named as corporate partners; check each company's own nonprofit page for specifics

Goodstack also offers non-software support for nonprofits:
•	A grants finder/writer tool to help identify and apply for funding opportunities.
•	Donation mechanisms to support fundraising campaigns.

TechSoup — Confirmed Offer Categories
TechSoup operates as a global network of 53 regional NGO partners (for India, typically accessed via the South/Southeast Asia hub at techsoupasia.org). Rather than a single discount list, TechSoup runs an ongoing donation/discount catalog. Confirmed categories and named partners include:
Category	Named Partners	What It Covers
Productivity & office software	Microsoft	Donated/discounted licenses (e.g., Microsoft 365-type productivity tools)
Creative software	Adobe	Discounted access to Adobe's creative and document tools
Networking & security	Cisco	Discounted networking hardware/software
Accounting software	Intuit	Discounted small-business/accounting tools (e.g., QuickBooks-type products)
Antivirus & security	Symantec	Discounted endpoint security/antivirus products
Hardware	Varies by region	Discounted or refurbished computers/equipment in some markets
Training & community	TechSoup's own “Quad” service (launched 2022)	Peer-to-peer community connecting nonprofits with tech experts, plus training webinars

📌 Note
TechSoup reports a large global scale — 11+ million technology products distributed, roughly $3.75 billion in cumulative IT savings, and over 208,000 organizations served across 60 countries — but the exact current product catalog for India specifically could not be confirmed directly in this session (the India/Asia pages returned access errors when fetched).

Quick Reference: Where to Register First
•	If your priority is Google for Nonprofits: register with Goodstack, since it's Google's confirmed validation partner.
•	If your priority is everyday software savings (Zoom, DocuSign, Asana, ChatGPT, Adobe): Goodstack's own marketplace covers all of these with one verification.
•	If your priority is Microsoft, Cisco, Intuit, or Symantec products: check TechSoup/techsoupasia.org, since these are historically TechSoup-distributed partnerships.
•	Either way, keep your core documents ready: registration certificate (Trust Deed/Society/Section 8), PAN, 12A, 80G, and NGO Darpan ID — both platforms will ask for similar proof of nonprofit status.
⚠ Please verify
Several product/offer pages on both techsoup.org and goodstack.org (including their dedicated catalog and India-region pages) returned access errors (403/404) when fetched for this document. The offers listed above reflect what could be directly confirmed from each platform's accessible pages, not a complete or guaranteed-current catalog.
Before applying, visit techsoupasia.org and goodstack.org directly to see the full, current list of offers available to organizations registered in India, since discount percentages, eligible plans, and partner lists change over time.

Sources
Goodstack — Home / Offers Overview
TechSoup — About Us / Network Overview
Wikipedia — TechSoup

Note: this catalog is a starting point, not a guarantee of current pricing or availability. Discounts, eligibility rules, and partner lists on both platforms change periodically — always confirm details on the live site before budgeting or committing to a plan.

ZOHO FOR NONPROFITS

A Step-by-Step Sign-Up & Activation Guide for Indian Nonprofits
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

What Is Zoho for Nonprofits?
Zoho for Nonprofits gives eligible charitable organizations wallet credits toward Zoho's full suite of business apps (CRM, email marketing, finance, HR, collaboration, and more) on a cost-shared basis, rather than a flat free tier.
•	Up to $5,000 (USD) in Zoho wallet credits per eligible organization.
•	Cost-sharing model: your organization pays 50% of the list price, and the remaining 50% is automatically deducted from your wallet credit balance.
•	Credits remain valid for 5 years and can be applied toward new subscriptions, renewals, upgrades, additional user seats, and add-ons across most of the Zoho One suite.
•	Excluded from the credit program: Zoho Voice, Zoho Sign API plans, Zoho Domains, Zoho Backstage, ManageEngine products, and premium/enterprise support add-ons.

India tip
Zoho explicitly lists India as one of the countries whose nonprofits can apply directly (alongside Australia, New Zealand, the UK, USA, and Canada) — organizations elsewhere generally need TechSoup validation instead.

Overview: The Journey in 5 Steps
1.	Check your eligibility
2.	Create a Zoho account
3.	Gather your organization's documents
4.	Submit the nonprofit application form
5.	Wait for approval and start using your credits

Step 1: Check Your Eligibility
Confirm your organization meets Zoho's baseline criteria before applying:
•	You are a registered nonprofit — in India, this includes Trusts, Societies, Section 8 companies, and organizations registered on the NGO Darpan portal.
•	Your organization is based in a country Zoho supports for direct application (India, Australia, New Zealand, UK, USA, Canada) — other countries typically apply through TechSoup validation instead.
•	You intend to use the credits for your organization's own operations, not to resell or redistribute access.
Step 2: Create a Zoho Account
If your organization doesn't already have one, sign up for a Zoho account using an email address tied to your organization — ideally your own domain rather than a personal address, since this account becomes the one your wallet credits attach to.
📌 Note
Credits attach to the specific email address used at registration and cannot be transferred to a different account later, so pick your primary admin's organizational email carefully before applying.
Step 3: Gather Your Organization's Documents
Have the following ready before you start the application:
•	Certificate of registration — Trust Deed, Society Registration Certificate, or Section 8 Company incorporation certificate.
•	Alternatively, a TechSoup Validation Token, if your organization has already been validated through TechSoup for another program.
•	PAN card, 12A certificate, 80G certificate, and NGO Darpan ID are useful supporting documents even where not explicitly listed as mandatory.
Step 4: Submit the Nonprofit Application Form
6.	Go to zoho.com/nonprofits/registration.html.
7.	Select India as your country/region.
8.	Fill in your organization's legal name, registration number, and mission details.
9.	Upload your certificate of registration (or TechSoup Validation Token).
10.	Submit the form for review.
Step 5: Wait for Approval and Start Using Your Credits
•	Processing typically takes up to 10 working days.
•	You'll receive a confirmation email with instructions on how to access your wallet credits once approved.
•	Apply your credits toward the specific Zoho apps your organization needs — e.g., Zoho CRM for donor/beneficiary management, Zoho Campaigns for outreach, Zoho Books for finance, or Zoho People for HR — keeping in mind the 50/50 cost-share on each purchase.
•	Track your remaining wallet balance regularly, since credits expire after 5 years.

Quick Checklist
•	☐ Confirm your organization is eligible (registered nonprofit in a supported country)
•	☐ Create a Zoho account using your organization's official email
•	☐ Collect registration certificate (or TechSoup Validation Token)
•	☐ Submit the application at zoho.com/nonprofits/registration.html
•	☐ Allow up to 10 working days for approval
•	☐ Track wallet credit usage and 5-year expiry

Sources
Zoho for Nonprofits — Registration Page

Note: Zoho periodically updates credit amounts, excluded products, and country eligibility. Please confirm current details on the official page (with India selected as your country) before applying.

TRAINING & DIGITAL SKILLS FOR NGOs

Free Courses and a Practical Plan for Building Your Team's Capability
Prepared for NGOs  | August 2026

The Problem This Addresses
Nonprofits routinely obtain free software and then fail to get value from it, because nobody has the time or confidence to learn it properly. A donated CRM that nobody can configure is not a saving; it is an unused licence and a quiet source of guilt.
The good news is that the same companies donating the software also fund substantial free training. This guide covers what is available and, more usefully, how a small team with no spare hours can actually work through it.

What's Available Free
Provider	What's Offered	Who It's For
IBM SkillsBuild	Free digital literacy, technical skills and career-readiness training. Covers cybersecurity, cloud computing, AI, open source and STEM, plus interview preparation and CV building.	Open access — staff, volunteers, and beneficiaries alike
Google for Nonprofits	Three short courses aimed at nonprofits: Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits; Optimize Creativity and Fundraising with AI; Build Smarter Workflows with AI. Plus case studies, how-to guides and a nonprofit newsletter.	Available to anyone, with or without a Google for Nonprofits account
Microsoft	AI and digital-skills training resources for nonprofit staff, alongside the Microsoft Learn platform.	Nonprofit staff, accessed via the nonprofit portal
AWS	A free Nonprofit Onboarding Concierge service guiding organisations through initial cloud setup.	Organisations new to AWS
Microsoft Azure	A free Nonprofit Azure Onboarding Concierge, equivalent to the AWS service.	Organisations new to Azure

Worth knowing
The Google courses and IBM SkillsBuild require no nonprofit verification at all. If your organisation is still working through eligibility paperwork elsewhere, staff can begin training today.

Two Onboarding Services Worth Using
The AWS and Azure onboarding concierge services deserve separate mention because they are unusual: free, human, and specific to your organisation's situation. Most nonprofits never claim them.
If you have activated cloud credits and are staring at an unfamiliar console wondering where to begin, this is precisely what those services exist for. Using one is likely to save more time than several hours of general courses.

Building a Skills Plan That Survives Contact With Reality
The standard advice — conduct a training-needs assessment, build a matrix, schedule quarterly sessions — assumes an HR function that most Indian NGOs do not have. What follows is scaled for a team where everyone is already fully committed.
Step 1: Identify the Single Points of Failure
Ask one question: if this person left tomorrow, what would we be unable to do? The answers are your real training priorities. Common ones in small NGOs:
•	Only one person knows how the donor database is structured.
•	Only one person can update the website.
•	Only one person holds the admin login for the Google or Microsoft account.
•	Only one person understands the financial reporting spreadsheet.
Training a second person in each of these is worth more than broad upskilling, and takes far less time.
Step 2: Pick One Skill Per Person Per Quarter
Not a curriculum — one skill. A quarter is long enough to absorb something genuinely, and short enough that it does not drift indefinitely. Three or four skills learned properly across a year beats a dozen half-started courses.
Step 3: Attach Learning to Live Work
•	Someone learning spreadsheets should build the report your organisation actually files, not a practice exercise.
•	Someone learning the CRM should migrate one real donor segment into it.
•	Someone learning AI tools should draft this month's genuine donor update with it.
Skills learned against real work stick. Skills learned against exercises usually do not.
Step 4: Protect the Time Explicitly
Training that happens "when things are quieter" never happens. Two hours blocked in the calendar, treated as seriously as a funder meeting, is the difference between a plan and an intention.
Step 5: Write Down What Was Learned
A short internal note — how our Workspace admin is configured, how the monthly report is produced — converts individual learning into organisational knowledge. This is the step that prevents the single-point-of-failure problem recurring with the next hire.

A Note on Training Beneficiaries, Not Only Staff
IBM SkillsBuild is open beyond your own team, and explicitly serves groups including people from underrepresented communities in STEM, neurodivergent individuals, women and girls across Asia-Pacific, and students in underserved districts. For organisations whose mission includes livelihoods, employability, or youth development, this is a programme resource rather than only an internal one.
If digital skills form part of what your organisation delivers, it is worth reviewing SkillsBuild as curriculum you do not have to build.

Quick Checklist
•	☐ List the tasks only one person in your organisation can do
•	☐ Pick a second person to learn each, one per quarter
•	☐ Book the AWS or Azure onboarding concierge if you hold cloud credits
•	☐ Try one Google AI course for nonprofits — no account needed
•	☐ Explore IBM SkillsBuild for both staff and, where relevant, beneficiaries
•	☐ Block training time in the calendar rather than leaving it to spare capacity
•	☐ Write a short internal note after each skill is learned

Sources
IBM Social Impact — SkillsBuild
Google for Nonprofits — courses and resources
Microsoft Nonprofit — skilling resources
Azure Nonprofit Credits — Onboarding Concierge
AWS Nonprofit Programs

Note: course catalogues and eligibility for these training programmes change over time. The IBM SkillsBuild audience groups listed above are drawn from IBM's own description of the programme. Confirm current offerings on each provider's site.

MAILCHIMP FOR NONPROFITS

A Step-by-Step Sign-Up & Activation Guide for Indian Nonprofits
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

What Is Mailchimp's Nonprofit Discount?
Mailchimp offers a discount on its paid email marketing and marketing automation plans to eligible nonprofit organizations, so program and communications teams can run newsletters, donor updates, and campaign outreach at a lower cost.
•	A percentage discount off Mailchimp's standard paid monthly plans for verified nonprofits (historically reported around 15%, though this should be confirmed at signup since Mailchimp's own page was not accessible during research for this guide).
•	Full access to Mailchimp's core marketing features on the discounted plan tier — audience segmentation, campaign automation, templates, and reporting.

⚠ Please verify
Mailchimp's dedicated nonprofit pages returned access errors when checked directly for this guide, so the discount percentage and current application flow described here could not be freshly verified. Treat the figures above as indicative, not confirmed, and check mailchimp.com directly (or your account's Billing settings) before budgeting around a specific discount amount.

General Steps to Apply (Based on Common Practice)
Mailchimp's nonprofit discount is typically applied to an existing paid account rather than through a separate standalone sign-up portal. The commonly understood path is:
Step 1: Check Your Eligibility
•	Your organization should be a registered nonprofit or charitable organization in good standing (in India: typically a registered Trust, Society, or Section 8 Company).
•	You should have — or be ready to create — a Mailchimp account under your organization's name.
Step 2: Gather Your Organization's Documents
•	Registration certificate — Trust Deed, Society Registration Certificate, or Section 8 Company incorporation certificate.
•	PAN card, 12A certificate, 80G certificate, and NGO Darpan ID as supporting proof of nonprofit status.
•	Proof of nonprofit status is sometimes verified directly by Mailchimp and, in other cases, through a third-party validator (historically TechSoup in several regions) — be ready for either path.
Step 3: Create or Upgrade Your Mailchimp Account
1.	Sign up for (or log in to) Mailchimp using an email tied to your organization.
2.	Choose the paid plan tier that fits your audience size and feature needs — the nonprofit discount applies as a reduction on top of this plan's list price.
3.	Look in your account's Billing or Plan settings for a nonprofit discount option, or contact Mailchimp support directly to ask about the current nonprofit program if you don't see one listed.
Step 4: Submit Verification
•	Provide your organization's registration details and supporting documents when prompted.
•	Approval timelines vary; watch your email (including spam folder) for any request for additional information.
•	Once verified, the discount should apply automatically to your ongoing subscription billing.
Step 5: Set Up Your Campaigns
•	Import your donor and beneficiary contact lists (with appropriate consent) to start building segmented audiences.
•	Use templates for newsletters, fundraising appeals, and event announcements to save staff time.
•	Review Mailchimp's reporting dashboard regularly to see what's driving engagement with your supporters.

Quick Checklist
•	☐ Confirm organization type is eligible (registered nonprofit)
•	☐ Collect registration certificate, PAN, 12A (and 80G/Darpan ID if applicable)
•	☐ Create or log in to your organization's Mailchimp account
•	☐ Check Billing/Plan settings for a nonprofit discount option, or contact support directly
•	☐ Submit verification documents when requested
•	☐ Confirm the exact discount percentage currently on offer before committing to a plan

Sources
Direct fetch attempts to Mailchimp's nonprofit-specific pages returned access errors during research for this guide, so no specific page could be cited as a source. The information above reflects general, widely reported knowledge about Mailchimp's nonprofit discount program rather than a freshly confirmed page read.

Recommendation: before applying, search “Mailchimp nonprofit discount” directly on mailchimp.com or ask their support team to confirm the current percentage, eligibility criteria, and verification process for organizations in India.

GITHUB FOR NONPROFITS

A Step-by-Step Sign-Up Guide for Indian Nonprofits
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

What Does GitHub Offer Nonprofits?
GitHub Social Impact is GitHub's programme for the nonprofit and social sector. It is relevant to any organization that writes software, manages data pipelines, maintains a website's source code, or wants a home for tools it builds and wishes to share.
•	Free GitHub Team plan for qualifying nonprofits — this is the standard offering, giving your organization private repositories with unlimited collaborators.
•	25% discount on GitHub Enterprise Cloud, as an alternative for organizations needing enterprise features such as advanced security or SAML single sign-on.

Which plan?

GitHub is often assumed to be for software companies only. In practice, nonprofits use it for a wider range of work:
•	Storing and version-controlling the source code of your website, so changes are reversible and attributable.
•	Managing data analysis scripts for programme monitoring and evaluation, so results are reproducible.
•	Collaborating with volunteer developers or a contracted agency, with a clear record of who changed what.
•	Publishing open-source tools your organization has built, so peer organizations can reuse them.

If none of these apply and your organization does not produce or commission software, this programme is likely lower priority than the communication and infrastructure programmes covered in the other guides in this set.

What Your Organisation Can Access, and What It Is Actually Good For
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

Why This Guide Exists
Most AI coverage aimed at nonprofits is either breathless or dismissive. This guide is neither. It sets out which AI tools your organisation can obtain free or discounted through the nonprofit programmes you may already be registered for, what each is genuinely useful for in day-to-day NGO work, and — equally important — where they should not be trusted.
If you have already registered with Google for Nonprofits, Microsoft Nonprofit, or Goodstack, you may have access to several of these without realising it.

What You Can Access
Provider	What's Offered	How to Get It
Google	Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Google Labs experimental tools. Workspace also includes AI features for volunteer management and grant applications.	Included with Google for Nonprofits — no separate application
Microsoft	Microsoft 365 Copilot at a 15% nonprofit discount ($25.50 USD per user/month, paid yearly). Copilot Studio for building AI agents.	Via the Microsoft Nonprofit portal, as an add-on to Microsoft 365
OpenAI	Discounts on ChatGPT Team and ChatGPT Enterprise plans.	Through Goodstack's nonprofit marketplace, once verified
AWS	Imagine Grant Pathfinder award: up to $200,000 cash plus $100,000 in AWS credit for generative AI projects. Also a $50M Public Sector Generative AI Impact Initiative.	Competitive application directly with AWS
Microsoft Power Apps	Build custom low-code AI apps — free for up to 10 users, then $2.50 USD per user/month.	Via the Microsoft Nonprofit portal

One important distinction
The AWS Pathfinder award is in a different category entirely from the others. The rest are tools you switch on; Pathfinder is a competitive grant requiring a serious project proposal. Do not treat them as comparable.

What These Tools Are Actually Good For
The honest answer is that AI is strong at first drafts and pattern-heavy work, and weak wherever being wrong carries a cost. Applied to NGO work, that maps roughly as follows.
Genuinely useful
•	Drafting and redrafting — grant applications, donor updates, programme reports. The first draft is the expensive part; AI makes it cheap. You still write the final version.
•	Summarising long documents — funder guidelines, government circulars, meeting transcripts. Ask for the obligations and deadlines specifically, rather than a general summary.
•	Translation and simplification — turning an English policy document into plain Hindi, or a technical report into language a community meeting can follow. Have a fluent speaker review anything that goes out.
•	Reformatting and structuring — turning messy field notes into a consistent table, or a long report into slide bullets.
•	Explaining unfamiliar material — a staff member encountering FCRA rules or a cloud billing dashboard for the first time can ask questions without needing a colleague's time.
Use with real caution
•	Anything factual that goes out unchecked. These systems produce confident, plausible, wrong answers — including invented statistics, citations, and legal provisions. Every fact in a published document needs a human source.
•	Beneficiary data. Do not paste names, health details, case notes, or anything identifying into a consumer AI tool. Enterprise and Team plans generally offer stronger data handling than free consumer tiers — check the specific terms of the plan you hold.
•	Decisions about people. Selecting beneficiaries, assessing need, or screening job applicants with AI introduces bias that is difficult to see and harder to justify to a funder or a community.
•	Financial or legal filings. A hallucinated section number in an FCRA return is your organisation's problem, not the model's.

A rule of thumb
A practical rule that holds up well: use AI freely for work you were going to check anyway, and avoid it for work you would be tempted not to check.

Getting Started — A Sensible Sequence
1.	Check what you already have. If you are registered with Google for Nonprofits, Gemini is likely already available to your staff. This costs nothing to confirm and may end the search.
2.	Pick one workflow, not ten. Choose a task your team does weekly and dislikes — drafting the monthly donor update, summarising field reports — and try AI on that alone for a month.
3.	Set a data rule before you start. Write down, in one sentence, what staff may and may not paste into these tools. Circulate it. This is far easier to establish at the outset than to retrofit.
4.	Take the free training. Google publishes three short courses aimed specifically at nonprofits: Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits, Optimize Creativity and Fundraising with AI, and Build Smarter Workflows with AI. These are available without a Google for Nonprofits account.
5.	Review after a month. Did it save time, or move time around? Be willing to conclude that a tool is not worth its subscription.

6.	Submit your organization name, organizational email, and basic details for each product you want (Express, Acrobat Pro, Creative Cloud).
7.	Because Creative Cloud access routes through TechSoup, you may be directed to complete or confirm TechSoup validation as part of this step.
8.	Watch your email for a validation message — Adobe's verification step typically completes within 1–3 business days.
Step 4: Start Using Your Adobe Apps
•	Once approved, sign in with your organizational Adobe account to activate your licenses.
•	Plan your license allocation with these limits in mind: up to 50 Adobe Express Premium licenses, up to 10 Acrobat Pro licenses, and Creative Cloud Pro licenses available at discounted rates without a stated cap.
•	Assign licenses to specific staff members rather than shared logins, since the program is intended for named nonprofit staff use.

Quick Checklist
•	☐ Confirm organization type is eligible (registered nonprofit, staff-only use)
•	☐ Collect registration certificate, PAN, 12A (and 80G/Darpan ID if applicable)
•	☐ Apply via Adobe's nonprofit program page with a valid organizational email
•	☐ Complete TechSoup verification for Creative Cloud access (1–3 business days)
•	☐ Assign licenses within limits: 50 Express Premium / 10 Acrobat Pro / Creative Cloud Pro at discount

Adobe for Nonprofits

CLOUD SERVICES NEEDING DIRECT VERIFICATION

Google Cloud, Project Shield & Oracle NetSuite.org — A Follow-Up Brief
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

Why This Document Is Different
The other guides in this set are built on details confirmed directly from each provider's own published pages. These three could not be verified that way — their pages either returned errors, required JavaScript that could not be rendered, or simply did not publish the programme details in question.
Rather than pad three separate guides with plausible-sounding but unconfirmed steps, this brief sets out honestly what is known, what is not, and exactly what to ask when your team follows up. Treat it as a research task list rather than an instruction manual.

⚠ Read this first
Nothing in this document should be relied upon as a confirmed programme term. Every figure or process described here needs checking against the provider directly before it informs a budget or a project plan.


1. Google Cloud Platform
What Was Confirmed
•	Google for Nonprofits confirms Google Maps Platform credits as part of its standard offer bundle — this is verified and covered in the Google for Nonprofits guide.
•	The Google for Nonprofits products page makes no mention of general-purpose Google Cloud Platform compute or storage credits.
•	Google Cloud is referenced in the Google for Nonprofits footer as an "advanced tool," but with no programme details attached.
What Could Not Be Confirmed
•	Whether a dedicated GCP compute-credit programme for nonprofits currently exists at all.
•	If it does, the credit amount, eligibility criteria, and whether it is available in India.
What to Ask
•	Contact Google Cloud sales directly and ask specifically: "Is there a nonprofit credit or discount programme for Google Cloud Platform compute and storage, separate from the Maps Platform credits in Google for Nonprofits, and is it available to an Indian registered nonprofit?"
•	If your organization is already registered with Google for Nonprofits, ask whether that registration carries any weight toward GCP pricing.
📌 Note
Practical read: if you need general-purpose cloud compute today, AWS ($1,000 via TechSoup) and Azure ($2,000/year via Microsoft Nonprofit) are the two confirmed, documented routes. Treat GCP as an open question rather than a gap in your plan.

2. Google Project Shield
What Is Believed to Be True
Project Shield is Google's free DDoS-protection service, operated by Jigsaw, aimed at news organizations, human rights groups, and election-monitoring bodies. It is the closest direct equivalent to Cloudflare's Project Galileo, and organizations that do not fit one programme sometimes fit the other.
What Could Not Be Confirmed
•	The specific protections included and how they compare to Cloudflare's Business-plan-equivalent offer.
•	Current eligibility criteria and whether Indian civil society organizations qualify.
•	The application process and typical decision timeline.
•	Whether the service remains open to new applicants on the same terms.

Repeated attempts to read Project Shield's own pages returned only a loading state, as the site renders its content via JavaScript. This is a limitation of how the page was fetched, not evidence that the programme has changed or closed.
What to Do
•	Visit projectshield.withgoogle.com directly in a browser, where the page will render normally.
•	Assess it alongside Cloudflare's Project Galileo rather than instead of it — the two have overlapping but not identical eligibility, and there is no penalty for investigating both.
•	If your organization's work touches journalism, human rights, or elections and has attracted hostile attention, both programmes are worth pursuing in parallel.

3. Oracle NetSuite.org
What Is Believed to Be True
NetSuite.org is Oracle's philanthropic arm, historically known for donating or discounting NetSuite's cloud ERP and CRM software to nonprofit organizations. NetSuite is a substantial finance, operations, and resource-planning platform — a different category of tool from the infrastructure credits covered elsewhere in this set.
What Could Not Be Confirmed
•	Whether the donation or discount programme is currently open.
•	The number of donated licenses or the discount percentage.
•	Eligibility criteria, and specifically whether Indian nonprofits are served.
•	The application process and implementation support available.
What to Ask
•	Contact NetSuite.org directly, or approach a NetSuite implementation partner operating in India — partners generally know the current state of the donation programme.
•	Ask specifically about implementation cost, not just licensing. NetSuite is a significant system to configure, and a donated license with a large implementation bill attached may not be the saving it appears to be.
A candid note
Before pursuing NetSuite, consider whether your organization's finance and operations needs are genuinely at ERP scale. For many nonprofits, Zoho Books or a similar tool at nonprofit pricing meets the need at a fraction of the implementation effort. ERP migrations consume considerable staff time even when the software itself is free.

Suggested Follow-Up Actions
•	☐ Email or call Google Cloud sales with the specific GCP nonprofit credit question above
•	☐ Open projectshield.withgoogle.com in a browser and assess eligibility against your organization's risk profile
•	☐ Apply to Cloudflare Project Galileo in parallel rather than waiting on Project Shield
•	☐ Contact NetSuite.org or an India-based NetSuite partner, asking about implementation cost as well as licensing
•	☐ Before pursuing ERP, honestly assess whether your finance needs are at that scale yet
•	☐ Record what you learn, so this brief can be replaced with confirmed detail

Sources
Google for Nonprofits — Products (confirms Maps credits, no GCP compute credit)
Google Project Shield (page did not render during research)

TWILIO.ORG IMPACT ACCESS PROGRAM

Communication APIs for NGOs — A Step-by-Step Guide for Indian Nonprofits
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

What Is the Impact Access Program?
Twilio.org is Twilio's social impact arm. Its Impact Access Program gives eligible organizations credits and discounts on Twilio's communication APIs — the infrastructure behind SMS, voice calls, WhatsApp messaging, and chatbots. For nonprofits running helplines, sending beneficiary alerts, or doing SMS-based outreach in the field, this is often more directly useful than raw compute credit.
•	$100 one-time product credit for eligible organizations — Twilio describes this as equivalent to thousands of complimentary text messages or voice calls.
•	Credits never expire, which matters for organizations whose campaigns run seasonally rather than continuously.
•	Ongoing discounts on a wide range of Twilio products beyond the initial credit.
•	No monthly contract requirement — you are not locked into a subscription to use the credit.
•	Access to an education hub with webinars, e-books, and sample code, plus a partner network for implementation help.

Scale of the programme
Twilio.org reports having provided $66M+ in grants, product credits, and discounts across 2025, with $224,000 specifically in product credits to social impact organizations. The $100 starter credit is the accessible entry point; larger support is negotiated separately through their sales team.

What Nonprofits Actually Build With It
Twilio's own framing of common nonprofit use cases is worth reading as a prompt for what your organization might do:
•	Alerts and notifications — reminding beneficiaries of appointments, deadlines, or entitlements by SMS.
•	Hotlines and helplines — routing inbound calls to trained staff or volunteers, including anonymously.
•	User authentication — verifying identities by SMS where beneficiaries lack email access.
•	Marketing and fundraising — donor outreach and campaign messaging.
•	WhatsApp-based programme delivery, which is particularly relevant given WhatsApp's reach across India.

Overview: The Journey in 5 Steps
1.	Check your eligibility
2.	Gather your organization's documents
3.	Submit your application
4.	Start building while you wait
5.	Deploy and apply your credit

Step 1: Check Your Eligibility
Twilio's Impact Access Program serves a broader range of organizations than most corporate nonprofit programmes:
•	Nonprofit organizations with 501(c)(3) status, and international nonprofit equivalents — which includes Indian Trusts, Societies, and Section 8 Companies.
•	Social enterprises are explicitly included, which is unusual and worth noting if your organization has a hybrid structure.
•	Twilio states that approximately 12 million nonprofits worldwide are eligible for instant approval through Goodstack.

India tip
If your organization is already verified with Goodstack — for example, through your Google for Nonprofits registration — you may qualify for instant approval here rather than a fresh review. This is a concrete benefit of having registered with Goodstack first.
Step 2: Gather Your Organization's Documents
•	Registration certificate — Trust Deed, Society Registration Certificate, or Section 8 Company incorporation certificate.
•	PAN card of the organization.
•	12A registration certificate, and 80G certificate if available.
•	NGO Darpan / NITI Aayog unique ID, if your organization has one.
•	If already Goodstack-verified, your existing verification may suffice — check before assembling everything from scratch.
Step 3: Submit Your Application
6.	Go to twilio.org and locate the Impact Access Program application.
7.	Complete the application with your organization's details and nonprofit status.
8.	Review Twilio's published eligibility guidelines if your organization's structure is unusual, as their support documentation covers edge cases in more detail than the main page.
9.	Expect a response within 2–5 business days.
Step 4: Start Building While You Wait
Twilio explicitly encourages organizations to begin development during the approval window rather than waiting idle. This is practical advice — the technical work of integrating an SMS or WhatsApp flow takes longer than the approval does.
•	Create a free Twilio account and explore the documentation and sample code.
•	Prototype your messaging flow using Twilio's trial credit before your programme credit arrives.
•	Identify whether you need in-house development, a technical specialist, or an implementation partner from Twilio's network.
Step 5: Deploy and Apply Your Credit
•	Once approved, your credit is applied to your Twilio account.
•	Because credits never expire, there is no pressure to spend quickly — but do model your per-message costs before a large campaign, as SMS pricing varies significantly by country and route.
•	For India specifically, check Twilio's local messaging regulations and sender ID requirements, as SMS delivery is subject to TRAI regulations and DLT registration.
⚠ India regulatory note
Sending commercial or transactional SMS in India requires registration on the DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) platform managed by Indian telecom operators, with registered sender IDs and message templates. This is a regulatory requirement independent of Twilio, and it takes time to complete — factor it into your project timeline before committing to an SMS-based programme.

Quick Checklist
•	☐ Confirm eligibility (nonprofit, international equivalent, or social enterprise)
•	☐ Check whether existing Goodstack verification gives you instant approval
•	☐ Collect registration certificate, PAN, 12A, 80G, NGO Darpan ID
•	☐ Submit the Impact Access Program application — expect 2–5 business days
•	☐ Begin prototyping your messaging flow while awaiting approval
•	☐ Investigate DLT registration requirements for SMS in India early
•	☐ Model per-message costs before launching a large campaign

Sources
Twilio.org — Home
Twilio.org — Impact Access Program
Twilio Support — Impact Access Program Eligibility Guidelines

Note: the DLT registration requirement described above reflects general knowledge of Indian telecom regulation rather than a Twilio-published statement, and was not verified against a live source during research. Confirm current requirements with Twilio and your telecom provider before planning an SMS programme.

A Step-by-Step Sign-Up & Activation Guide for Indian Nonprofits
Prepared for NGOs  |  August 2026

What Is Canva for Nonprofits?
Canva for Nonprofits gives eligible charitable organizations free access to Canva for Teams — Canva's premium collaborative plan — so your staff and volunteers can design flyers, social posts, reports, presentations, and campaign materials without a paid subscription. Once approved, your organization typically gets:
•	Canva for Teams (formerly Canva for Enterprise/Pro features) at no cost for eligible team members
•	Premium templates, stock photos, videos, audio, and fonts from Canva's paid content library
•	Brand Kit — store your logo, brand colors, and fonts so every team member designs on-brand
•	Background Remover, Magic Resize, Magic Studio/AI design tools, and other premium editing features
•	Content Planner for scheduling social media posts directly from Canva
•	Real-time collaboration, shared folders, and team libraries for staff and volunteers

📌 Before you start
Canva's nonprofit program is generally not available to government entities, schools/educational institutions (Canva for Education covers that sector separately), political organizations, and individuals — only registered nonprofit/charitable organizations qualify.

Overview: The Journey in 5 Steps
1.	Check your eligibility
2.	Gather your organization's documents
3.	Apply for Canva for Nonprofits
4.	Complete verification
5.	Set up your team and start designing

Step 1: Check Your Eligibility
Before applying, confirm your organization meets Canva's baseline criteria:
•	You are a registered nonprofit or charitable organization in good standing (in India: typically a registered Trust, Society, or Section 8 Company).
•	Your organization operates on a not-for-profit basis with a public-benefit mission.
•	You are not a government body, school or academic institution, political party, or an individual applying in a personal capacity.
•	Your organization's country is supported by Canva's nonprofit program (India is generally supported, but availability of specific features can vary by region).

Because Canva periodically updates its eligibility rules, confirm the current criteria on Canva's official nonprofit page before you apply.
Step 2: Gather Your Organization's Documents
Canva verifies nonprofit status either directly or through a validation partner, using your registration details and supporting documents. For an Indian organization, keep the following ready:
•	Registration certificate — Trust Deed, Society Registration Certificate, or Section 8 Company incorporation certificate
•	PAN card of the organization
•	12A registration certificate (income tax exemption for nonprofits)
•	80G certificate, if available
•	NGO Darpan / NITI Aayog unique ID, if your organization has one
•	A brief description of your organization's mission and the work it does
•	An organizational email address (using your own domain, where possible) for the primary Canva account admin

📌 India tip
Exact document requirements can vary and are sometimes verified through a third-party partner rather than checked manually by Canva. Follow the specific checklist shown on the application form for India rather than relying solely on this list.
Step 3: Apply for Canva for Nonprofits
6.	Go to Canva's nonprofit program page (canva.com/canva-for-nonprofits) and select “Get verified” / “Apply now.”
7.	Sign in with (or create) a Canva account for your organization — ideally using an admin email tied to your organization's domain.
8.	Select India as your country/region so you see the correct eligibility rules.
9.	Fill in your organization's legal name, registration number/ID, mission description, and website, and upload the supporting documents gathered in Step 2.
10.	Review and accept Canva's nonprofit program terms, then submit your application.
Step 4: Complete Verification
After you submit your application, Canva (directly or via its validation partner) reviews your organization's legal and charitable status.
•	Processing time varies, but plan for anywhere from a few days up to a couple of weeks.

•	You'll receive an email confirming approval, after which your account is upgraded to Canva for Teams under the nonprofit program.

•	Once approved, go to your Canva account settings and invite staff and volunteers to your team so they can access the nonprofit plan's premium features.
•	Set up your Brand Kit with your organization's logo, brand colors, and fonts so every design stays consistent.
•	Explore premium templates for flyers, annual reports, social media posts, presentations, and fundraising campaign materials.
•	Use the Content Planner to schedule social posts, and Magic Studio/AI tools to speed up repetitive design tasks.
•	Assign a team admin (or a couple of backup admins) so design assets and templates aren't lost if one staff member leaves.
